translation: Ng'alek che lel agobo emotinwek ak betusiek che let ab chutet eng' sukul, koit eng' email neng'ung'.

english: Studies and Awards Limited. All rights reserved.
kiswahili: Studies and Awards Limited. Haki zote zimehifadhiwa.
translation: Studies and Awards Limited. Kiripei haki tugul.

english: A free consultation, at our office in Eldoret or online, to choose your course and school
kiswahili: Ushauri wa bure, ofisini kwetu Eldoret au mtandaoni, kuchagua kozi na shule yako

english: IELTS, PTE or German classes, in class or online
kiswahili: Madarasa ya IELTS, PTE au Kijerumani, darasani au mtandaoni
translation: Kilasisiek ab IELTS, PTE anan Kijerumani, eng' kilasit anan online

english: Documentation: the documents you need, certified and clearly scanned
kiswahili: Nyaraka: nyaraka unazohitaji, zilizothibitishwa na kuskaniwa vizuri
translation: Karatasisiek: karatasisiek che imache, che kakigimit ak kakiskan komie

english: Verification of every document with whoever issued it
kiswahili: Uthibitishaji wa kila hati na aliyeitoa
translation: Kegimit imanit ab karatasit age tugul ak chii ne kogoon

english: Your application, offer and confirmation of enrolment
kiswahili: Ombi lako, ofa na uthibitisho wa kujiandikisha
translation: Aplikesheni neng'ung', ofa ak confirmation of enrolment (CoE)

english: Your student visa, then a discounted student flight
kiswahili: Visa yako ya mwanafunzi, kisha tiketi ya ndege ya mwanafunzi kwa punguzo
translation: Visa neng'ung' ab kipsomaniat, yeityo tiketit ab ndegeit ab kipsomaniat ne olyet ne ming'in

english: Confirm the current rules with a counsellor
kiswahili: Thibitisha kanuni za sasa na mshauri
translation: Gimit ng'atutik che mi raini ak kirwogindet

english: Book a free consultation, or explore our other study destinations.
kiswahili: Weka miadi ya ushauri wa bure, au gundua nchi zetu nyingine za kusoma.
translation: Som kirwoget ne ma kelipani, anan keer emotinwek chenyo alak ab somanet.

english: Plan your studies abroad with people who walk you through every step.
kiswahili: Panga masomo yako nje ya nchi na watu wanaokuongoza kila hatua.
translation: Chob somanet neng'ung' eng' sang' ab emet ak biik che indochin eng' hatua age tugul.

english: We guide you from choosing a course to applying, your English test and your visa for the UK, Canada, Australia, Germany, Ireland and New Zealand. Each step has its own team in our Eldoret office.
kiswahili: Tunakuongoza kuanzia kuchagua kozi hadi kuomba, mtihani wako wa Kiingereza na visa yako ya Uingereza, Kanada, Australia, Ujerumani, Ayalandi na New Zealand. Kila hatua ina timu yake katika ofisi yetu ya Eldoret.
translation: Kitoretin kong'eten kolewen kozi agoi kosir aplikesheni, tiemutik neng'ung' ab Kiingereza ak visa neng'ung' ab Uingereza, Kanada, Australia, Ujerumani, Ayalandi ak New Zealand. Hatua age tugul tinye timit nenyin eng' ofisit nenyo ab Eldoret.

english: Six steps from your first meeting with us, at our Eldoret office or online, to your first day abroad, each handled by its own team.
kiswahili: Hatua sita kuanzia mkutano wako wa kwanza nasi, katika ofisi yetu ya Eldoret au mtandaoni, hadi siku yako ya kwanza ughaibuni, kila moja ikishughulikiwa na timu yake.
translation: Hatua lo kong'eten tuiyet neng'ung' ne tai ak acheek, eng' ofisit nenyo ab Eldoret anan online, agoi betut neng'ung' ne tai eng' sang' ab emet. Hatua age tugul ko tinye timit nenyin.

english: See every step and who looks after it
translation: Keer hatua age tugul ak chii ne ripei

kiswahili: ORODHA YA KUSOMA NJE YA NCHI
translation: ORODHA AB SOMANET EN SANG' AB EMET

english: Talk to us about your grades, budget and goals, at our office in Eldoret or online. Your first consultation is free.
kiswahili: Zungumza nasi kuhusu alama zako, bajeti na malengo yako, katika ofisi yetu Eldoret au mtandaoni. Ushauri wako wa kwanza ni bure.
translation: Ng'alal ak acheek agobo maksisiek neng'ung', bajeti ak kabwaatutik neng'ung', eng' ofisit nenyo ab Eldoret anan online. Kirwoget neng'ung' ne tai ko ma kelipani.

english: IELTS, PTE or German, in class during the day or online in the evening. Already sat IELTS elsewhere? You go straight to documentation.
kiswahili: IELTS, PTE au Kijerumani, darasani wakati wa mchana au mtandaoni jioni. Tayari ulifanya IELTS mahali pengine? Unaruka moja kwa moja hadi nyaraka.
translation: IELTS, PTE anan Kijerumani, eng' kilasit eng' betut anan online eng' koskoleny. Kakiyai IELTS eng' ole age? Iwe chokyi eng' karatasisiek.

english: We tell you exactly which documents you need, certified by a lawyer and clearly scanned.
kiswahili: Tunakuambia hasa nyaraka unazohitaji, zikiwa zimethibitishwa na wakili na kuskaniwa vizuri.
translation: Kimwochin karatasisiek chu imache tugul, che kakigimit eng' wakili ak kakiskan komie.

english: Every certificate and bank statement is confirmed with whoever issued it.
kiswahili: Kila cheti na taarifa ya benki huthibitishwa na aliyekitoa.
translation: Kegimit sertifiket age tugul ak bank statement ak chii ne kogoon.

english: Health cover, medical examination and biometrics bookings, your visa application entered and audited, then a discounted student flight.
kiswahili: Bima ya afya, uchunguzi wa kimatibabu na miadi ya alama za vidole, ombi lako la visa kujazwa na kukaguliwa, kisha tiketi ya ndege ya wanafunzi kwa bei nafuu.
translation: Bima ab konyoiset, tiemutik ab kanyoiset ak betut ab biometrics, aplikesheni neng'ung' ab visa ne kakisir ak kakikeer, yeityo tiketit ab ndegeit ab kipsomaniat ne olyet ne ming'in.

english: We help you access quality education in top destinations around the world. Choose from a wide range of countries, universities and programs.
kiswahili: Tunakusaidia kupata elimu bora katika nchi zinazoongoza duniani. Chagua kutoka nchi, vyuo vikuu na programu mbalimbali.
translation: Kitoretin konyor somanet ne kararan eng' emotinwek che bo tai eng' ng'wony. Lewen eng' emotinwek, univasitisiek ak programisiek chechang'.

english: Tuition-friendly public universities. Our language training gets you ready.
kiswahili: Vyuo vikuu vya umma vyenye ada nafuu. Mafunzo yetu ya lugha yanakuandaa.
translation: Univasitisiek ab serikali che robinik ab sukul ko ming'in. Somanet nenyo ab kutit kochobin.

kiswahili: Kwa nini uchague Studies and Awards
translation: Amu nee ilewen Studies and Awards

english: One consultancy, every step of the journey.
kiswahili: Kampuni moja ya ushauri, kila hatua ya safari.
translation: Kampuni agenge ab kirwoget, hatua age tugul ab oret.

english: Studies and Awards Limited is an educational consultancy based in Eldoret, Kenya, working with students from all over the country. We help students choose the right course and country, prepare for English tests, apply to schools, get their visas and travel.
kiswahili: Studies and Awards Limited ni kampuni ya ushauri wa elimu yenye makao Eldoret, Kenya, inayofanya kazi na wanafunzi kutoka kote nchini. Tunawasaidia wanafunzi kuchagua kozi na nchi sahihi, kujiandaa kwa mitihani ya Kiingereza, kutuma maombi shuleni, kupata visa na kusafiri.
translation: Studies and Awards Limited ko kampuni ab kirwoget ab somanet ne mi Eldoret, Kenya, ne boisie ak kipsomaninik che bunu emet tugul. Kitoretin kipsomaninik kolewen kozi ak emet ne nyolu, kochobgei tiemutik ab Kiingereza, kosir aplikesheni eng' sukulisiek, konyor visa ak kowendi.

english: Studied abroad with us? Share your story
kiswahili: Ulisoma ughaibuni kupitia sisi? Shiriki hadithi yako
translation: Ki isomane eng' sang' ab emet ak acheek? Mwa ng'alek neng'ung'

english: The questions students and parents ask us most. Anything else, call us on +254 721 796500.
kiswahili: Maswali tunayoulizwa zaidi na wanafunzi na wazazi. Kwa jingine lolote, tupigie kwa +254 721 796500.
translation: Teebutik che teebech kipsomaninik ak sigik chechang'. Ng'olyon age tugul, pirchi acheek eng' +254 721 796500.

english: Do you offer IELTS and PTE classes?
kiswahili: Je, mnatoa madarasa ya IELTS na PTE?
translation: Tos itinye kilasisiek ab IELTS ak PTE?

english: Yes. Our trainers teach IELTS and PTE in person and online, and we can also register you for the exam.
kiswahili: Ndiyo. Wakufunzi wetu hufundisha IELTS na PTE ana kwa ana na mtandaoni, na tunaweza pia kukusajili kwa mtihani.
translation: Ee. Konetik chenyo koneti IELTS ak PTE eng' kilasit ak online, ak kimuchi kosir kaineng'ung' eng' tiemutik.

english: Can you help me with my visa?
kiswahili: Je, mnaweza kunisaidia na visa yangu?
translation: Tos imuchi kotoretan eng' visa nenyun?

english: Yes. Our visa team arranges your health cover, books your medical examination and biometrics appointment, fills in your visa application for you and audits it before it is submitted.
kiswahili: Ndiyo. Timu yetu ya visa hupanga bima yako ya afya, huweka miadi ya uchunguzi wa kimatibabu na alama za vidole, hujaza ombi lako la visa na kulikagua kabla halijawasilishwa.
translation: Ee. Timit nenyo ab visa kochobei bima neng'ung' ab konyoiset, kosomei betut ab tiemutik ab kanyoiset ak biometrics, kosirei aplikesheni neng'ung' ab visa ak kokeerei kotomo keyokte.

english: Which countries can I study in?
Australia, New Zealand, Ireland and Germany, as well as the United Kingdom and Canada. A counsellor will help you choose.
kiswahili: Australia, New Zealand, Ayalandi na Ujerumani, pamoja na Uingereza na Kanada. Mshauri atakusaidia kuchagua.
translation: Australia, New Zealand, Ayalandi ak Ujerumani, kobooto Uingereza ak Kanada. Kirwogindet kotoretin kolewen.

kiswahili: Je, mnasaidia na safari za ndege?

english: Yes. Through our partnership with Reserve Trip Kenya, our students can get discounted student air tickets.
kiswahili: Ndiyo. Kupitia ushirikiano wetu na Reserve Trip Kenya, wanafunzi wetu wanaweza kupata tiketi za ndege za wanafunzi kwa bei nafuu.
translation: Ee. Eng' kiboisiet nenyo ak Reserve Trip Kenya, imuchi kipsomaninik chenyo konyor tiketisiek ab ndegeit ab kipsomaninik che olyet ne ming'in.

english: Can I get help with school fees?
kiswahili: Je, naweza kupata msaada wa ada ya shule?
translation: Tos amuchi anyor toretet eng' robinik ab sukul?

english: Ask us about financial support through Magister Sacco.
kiswahili: Tuulize kuhusu msaada wa kifedha kupitia Magister Sacco.
translation: Teebe acheek agobo toretet ab rabinik eng' Magister Sacco.

english: Daima Towers, Mezzanine 1, Eldoret, adjacent to Marie Stopes Eldoret.
kiswahili: Daima Towers, Mezzanine 1, Eldoret, karibu na Marie Stopes Eldoret.
translation: Daima Towers, Mezzanine 1, Eldoret, ole ne negit ak Marie Stopes Eldoret.

english: Visit our office at Daima Towers, Eldoret, or meet our team online.
kiswahili: Tembelea ofisi yetu Daima Towers, Eldoret, au kutana na timu yetu mtandaoni.
translation: Ibun ofisit nenyo eng' Daima Towers, Eldoret, anan itorookte timit nenyo online.

english: One team with you from your first meeting to your visa.
kiswahili: Timu moja pamoja nawe kuanzia mkutano wa kwanza hadi visa yako.
translation: Timit agenge ne mi ak inyee kong'eten tuiyet ne tai agoi visa neng'ung'.

english: Every student goes through the same six steps with us, whichever of our six countries they choose. Each step has its own team in our office at Daima Towers, Eldoret, so you always know who is looking after you.
kiswahili: Kila mwanafunzi hupitia hatua zile zile sita nasi, awe amechagua nchi yoyote kati ya nchi zetu sita. Kila hatua ina timu yake katika ofisi yetu Daima Towers, Eldoret, ili ujue kila wakati ni nani anayekuhudumia.
translation: Kipsomaniat age tugul kobunu hatua lo che kergei ak acheek, agot ko lewen emet ainon eng' emotinwek chenyo lo. Hatua age tugul ko tinye timit nenyin eng' ofisit nenyo eng' Daima Towers, Eldoret, si inai kasarta age tugul chii ne ripin.

english: Visit our office at Daima Towers in Eldoret, or meet our team online from anywhere in Kenya. We talk through your grades, budget and goals, and help you choose the country, course and school that suit you. Every member of our team gives consultations, so whoever you meet first can get you started.
kiswahili: Tembelea ofisi yetu Daima Towers mjini Eldoret, au kutana na timu yetu mtandaoni popote nchini Kenya. Tunazungumzia alama zako, bajeti na malengo yako, na kukusaidia kuchagua nchi, kozi na shule zinazokufaa. Kila mwanachama wa timu yetu hutoa ushauri, kwa hivyo yeyote utakayekutana naye kwanza anaweza kukuanzisha.
translation: Ibun ofisit nenyo eng' Daima Towers ab Eldoret, anan itorookte timit nenyo online kong'eten ole age tugul eng' Kenya. Kingalal agobo maksisiek neng'ung', bajeti ak kabwaatutik neng'ung', ak kitoretin kolewen emet, kozi ak sukul che nyolu inyee. Chii age tugul eng' timit nenyo kogochi kirwoget, kou noton chii ne itorookte tai komuchi kotaunin.

kiswahili: Alama zako, bajeti na malengo yako
translation: Maksisiek neng'ung', bajeti ak kabwaatutik neng'ung'

english: The countries, courses and schools that fit them
kiswahili: Nchi, kozi na shule zinazolingana nazo
translation: Emotinwek, kosisiek ak sukulisiek che nyolu

english: Whether you have already sat IELTS elsewhere. If you have the score you need, you go straight to step 3.
kiswahili: Iwapo tayari ulifanya IELTS mahali pengine. Ukiwa na alama unazohitaji, unaruka moja kwa moja hadi hatua ya 3.
translation: Ngo kakiyai IELTS eng' ole age. Ngo itinye maksisiek che imache, iwe chokyi eng' hatua 3.

english: Any member of our team. Meet the team
kiswahili: Mwanachama yeyote wa timu yetu. Kutana na timu
translation: Chii age tugul eng' timit nenyo. Torookte timit

english: Witney prepares you for your English test, IELTS or PTE. If you are going to Germany, Karen teaches you German. Either way, you choose how you learn.
kiswahili: Witney anakuandaa kwa mtihani wako wa Kiingereza, IELTS au PTE. Ukienda Ujerumani, Karen anakufundisha Kijerumani. Kwa vyovyote vile, wewe huchagua jinsi ya kujifunza.
translation: Witney kochobin eng' tiemutik neng'ung' ab Kiingereza, IELTS anan PTE. Ngo iwe Ujerumani, Karen koneti inyee Kijerumani. Eng' oret age tugul, inyee ne ilewen ole isomane.

english: In classAt Daima Towers, during the day
OnlineIn the evening, from wherever you are
translation: OnlineEng' koskoleny, kong'eten ole age tugul ne imi

english: Already sat IELTS elsewhere with the score you need? Go straight to step 3
kiswahili: Tayari ulifanya IELTS mahali pengine na una alama unazohitaji? Nenda moja kwa moja hadi hatua ya 3
translation: Kakiyai IELTS eng' ole age ak itinye maksisiek che imache? Ui chokyi eng' hatua 3

english: Rahab tells you exactly which documents your application needs, and keeps them safely on file once they are in. When your documents are complete and approved, she passes your file on to our compliance team.
kiswahili: Rahab anakuambia hasa nyaraka ambazo ombi lako linahitaji, na anazihifadhi salama zikishafika. Nyaraka zako zikikamilika na kuidhinishwa, anapitisha faili yako kwa timu yetu ya utiifu.
translation: Rahab komwochin karatasisiek che mache aplikesheni neng'ung', ak koripei komie ye kakobit. Ye kakobit karatasisiek neng'ung' tugul ak kakiyan, koyokte faili neng'ung' eng' timit nenyo ab compliance.

english: Each document certified by a lawyer
translation: Karatasit age tugul ne kakigimit eng' wakili
Ne kakeyokte acheek eng' oret ne tinye kaalyeet

english: Canisius and Dennis check that every document you have given us is authentic, by confirming it with whoever issued it. Only once everything has been checked does your file move on to the application team.
kiswahili: Canisius na Dennis hukagua kwamba kila hati uliyotupa ni halali, kwa kuthibitisha na aliyeitoa. Ni baada ya kila kitu kukaguliwa tu ndipo faili yako huendelea kwa timu ya maombi.
translation: Canisius ak Dennis kokeerei ile karatasit age tugul ne kiikonech ko imanit, eng' kogimit ak chii ne kogoon. Ye kakigeer tugul kityo, ko kowe faili neng'ung' eng' timit ab aplikesheni.

english: Certificates confirmed with the school or college that issued them
kiswahili: Vyeti vilivyothibitishwa na shule au chuo vilivyovitoa
translation: Sertifiketisiek che kakigimit ak sukul anan koleji ne kigoon

english: Bank statements confirmed with the bank
kiswahili: Taarifa za benki zilizothibitishwa na benki
translation: Bank statements che kakigimit ak benki

english: Every document checked before anything goes to a school
kiswahili: Kila hati hukaguliwa kabla ya chochote kutumwa shuleni
translation: Kekeerei karatasit age tugul kotomo keyokte kiy age eng' sukul

english: Joy helps you settle on the course and school that best match what you want. Once you agree, she applies for you and follows up until your offer letter arrives, conditional or unconditional.
kiswahili: Joy anakusaidia kuamua kozi na shule zinazolingana zaidi na unachotaka. Mkikubaliana, anakutumia maombi na kufuatilia hadi barua yako ya ofa ifike, iwe ya masharti au isiyo na masharti.
translation: Joy kotoretin kolewen kozi ak sukul che nyolu ne imache. Ye kakiyan, kosirchin aplikesheni ak kosubei agoi kobit baruet neng'ung' ab ofa, ne tinye ng'atutik anan ne ma tinye ng'atutik.

english: Ian makes sure every condition on your offer is met, including the documents the school asks for before it approves you (its GTE requirements). If the school asks for a statement of purpose (GSR) explaining why you want to study there, Beatrice and the GSR team write it for you. Ian then sends everything back to the school.
kiswahili: Ian huhakikisha kila sharti la ofa yako linatimizwa, ikiwemo nyaraka ambazo shule huomba kabla ya kukuidhinisha (mahitaji yake ya GTE). Shule ikiomba taarifa ya madhumuni (GSR) inayoeleza kwa nini unataka kusoma huko, Beatrice na timu ya GSR wanakuandikia. Kisha Ian hutuma kila kitu kurudi shuleni.
translation: Ian kokeerei ile kakiyai ng'atutik tugul che mi ofa neng'ung', kobooto karatasisiek che mache sukul kotomo koyan inyee (GTE requirements). Ngo komache sukul statement of purpose (GSR) ne mwoe amu nee imache isomane emonoton, ko Beatrice ak timit ab GSR kosirchin. Yeityo Ian kogochi sukul tuguk tugul.
Robinik ab sukul ak confirmation of enrolment

english: When the school approves you, Winnie, our application manager, makes sure your fees are paid and your confirmation of enrolment (CoE) is issued. Winnie oversees every application from start to finish.
kiswahili: Shule ikikuidhinisha, Winnie, meneja wetu wa maombi, huhakikisha ada yako imelipwa na uthibitisho wako wa kujiandikisha (CoE) umetolewa. Winnie husimamia kila ombi kuanzia mwanzo hadi mwisho.
translation: Ye kakoyan sukul inyee, Winnie, ne ripei aplikesheni chenyo (Application Manager), kokeerei ile kakilipan robinik neng'ung' ab sukul ak kakigochin confirmation of enrolment (CoE). Winnie koripei aplikesheni age tugul kong'eten taunet agoi kogeskei.

english: Mourine and Joyner take care of every part of your visa application, from your health cover to your biometrics.
kiswahili: Mourine na Joyner hushughulikia kila sehemu ya ombi lako la visa, kuanzia bima yako ya afya hadi alama zako za vidole.
translation: Mourine ak Joyner koripei tuguk tugul che mi aplikesheni neng'ung' ab visa, kong'eten bima neng'ung' ab konyoiset agoi biometrics.
Kakisom betut ab tiemutik ab kanyoiset

english: Visa data entry: your application form filled in for you
kiswahili: Uingizaji wa data ya visa: fomu yako ya maombi hujazwa kwa ajili yako
translation: Visa data entry: kesirchin fomit neng'ung' ab aplikesheni

english: Visa audit: the whole application checked, your statement of purpose included, before it is submitted
kiswahili: Ukaguzi wa visa: ombi zima hukaguliwa, pamoja na taarifa yako ya madhumuni, kabla ya kuwasilishwa
translation: Visa audit: kekeerei aplikesheni tugul, kobooto statement of purpose neng'ung', kotomo keyokte

kiswahili: Miadi ya alama za vidole imewekwa

english: Once your visa is granted, Mourine books your flight at a discounted student fare.
kiswahili: Visa yako ikishatolewa, Mourine anakukatia tiketi ya ndege kwa nauli nafuu ya wanafunzi.
translation: Ye kakigochin visa, Mourine kosomchin tiketit ab ndegeit ne olyet ne ming'in ab kipsomaninik.

english: Book a free consultation and we'll map out the right services for you.
kiswahili: Omba ushauri bila malipo nasi tutakupangia huduma zinazokufaa.
translation: Som kirwoget ne ma kelipani ak kitoretin kolewen toretet che nyolu inyee.

english: Our office is on Mezzanine 1 of Daima Towers in Eldoret.
kiswahili: Ofisi yetu iko Mezzanine 1 ya Daima Towers mjini Eldoret.
translation: Ofisit nenyo ko mi Mezzanine 1 eng' Daima Towers, Eldoret.

english: Ground floor: come to Daima Towers
kiswahili: Ghorofa ya chini: njoo Daima Towers
translation: Ng'wony (Ground floor): nyo eng' Daima Towers

english: on WhatsApp (opens in a new tab)
translation: eng' WhatsApp (yatei eng' tab ne lel)
Daima Towers, ye kegeer kong'eten oret
Ramani ne boru Daima Towers, Eldoret

english: Photos of the building, entrance and reception
kiswahili: Picha za jengo, mlango na mapokezi
translation: Pichainik ab kaa ne oo, kurgeet ak reception

kiswahili: Picha 2 kati ya 3: mlango wa ofisi

english: Built in Eldoret, working across six countries.
kiswahili: Tulianzia Eldoret, tunafanya kazi katika nchi sita.
translation: Kitaunech eng' Eldoret, kiboisie eng' emotinwek lo.

english: Studies and Awards Limited is an education consultancy connecting Kenyan students to trusted university partners abroad, from application to arrival.
kiswahili: Studies and Awards Limited ni kampuni ya ushauri wa elimu inayounganisha wanafunzi wa Kenya na washirika wa vyuo vikuu wanaoaminika ughaibuni, kuanzia maombi hadi kufika.
translation: Studies and Awards Limited ko kampuni ab kirwoget ab somanet ne tuiyei kipsomaninik ab Kenya ak univasitisiek che kiboisie ak acheek eng' sang' ab emet, kong'eten aplikesheni agoi ye kakobit.

english: Hover over a country to see its route, click to explore it
kiswahili: Elekeza kipanya kwenye nchi kuona njia yake, bofya kuigundua
translation: Ib mouse eng' emet si ikeer oret nenyin, inyil si ikeer alak

english: Tap a country to see its route, tap again to explore it
kiswahili: Gusa nchi kuona njia yake, gusa tena kuigundua
translation: Nyil emet si ikeer oret nenyin, inyil kora si ikeer alak

english: We envision a future where every Kenyan student has the opportunity to pursue international education, supported by expert guidance and tailored solutions that enable them to thrive academically and professionally on a global scale.
kiswahili: Tunaona mustakabali ambapo kila mwanafunzi wa Kenya ana fursa ya kufuata elimu ya kimataifa, akisaidiwa na mwongozo wa kitaalamu na suluhisho zilizoundwa mahususi zinazomwezesha kufanikiwa kitaaluma na kikazi katika kiwango cha kimataifa.
translation: Kikabwatei kasarta ne bo tai ne tinye kipsomaniat age tugul ab Kenya oret ab somanet eng' emotinwek alak, kotoreti kirwoget ab biik che ngen ak toretet ne nyolu ineendet, si kosuldoi eng' somanet ak eng' boisiet eng' ng'wony tugul.

english: The three promises behind every application we handle, from your first visit to your visa.
kiswahili: Ahadi tatu zilizo nyuma ya kila ombi tunalolishughulikia, kuanzia ziara yako ya kwanza hadi visa yako.
translation: Kayasyosiek somok che mi aplikesheni age tugul ne kiripei, kong'eten ye ibun ofisit tai agoi visa neng'ung'.

english: From IELTS training to visa compliance, it's all handled in the same Eldoret office. Your file doesn't get handed between agencies.
kiswahili: Kuanzia mafunzo ya IELTS hadi utiifu wa visa, yote hushughulikiwa katika ofisi ile ile ya Eldoret. Faili yako haitupwi kati ya mashirika tofauti.
translation: Kong'eten somanet ab IELTS agoi compliance ab visa, tugul kiyaei eng' ofisit agenge ab Eldoret. Ma kiwech faili neng'ung' kong'eten kampuni agenge agoi age.

english: Partnerships, strategy and anything that needs senior attention.
kiswahili: Ushirikiano, mkakati na jambo lolote linalohitaji umakini wa juu.
translation: Kiboisiet ak kampunisiek alak, kabwaatutik ab kampuni ak ng'olyon age tugul ne mache kiptaiyat ne oo.

english: Reaching the Director, and following up on her behalf.
kiswahili: Kumfikia Mkurugenzi, na kufuatilia kwa niaba yake.
translation: Konyor Director, ak kosubei tuguk che ripei ineendet.

english: Preparing and submitting your applications abroad, including GTE preparation and assessments.
kiswahili: Kuandaa na kuwasilisha maombi yako ughaibuni, ikiwemo maandalizi na tathmini za GTE.
translation: Kochob ak koyokte aplikesheni neng'ung' eng' sang' ab emet, kobooto chobet ak keret ab GTE.

english: Preparing and organising the documents your application needs.
kiswahili: Kuandaa na kupanga nyaraka ambazo ombi lako linahitaji.
translation: Kochob ak koiten karatasisiek che mache aplikesheni neng'ung'.

english: Checking your documents before they go to institutions and visa authorities.
kiswahili: Kukagua nyaraka zako kabla hazijaenda kwa taasisi na mamlaka za visa.
translation: Kokeer karatasisiek neng'ung' kotomo kowe sukulisiek ak biik che ripei visa.

english: Guiding you through your visa application.
kiswahili: Kukuongoza katika ombi lako la visa.
translation: Koindochin eng' aplikesheni neng'ung' ab visa.

english: The GSR part of your application.
kiswahili: Sehemu ya GSR ya ombi lako.
translation: Hatua ab GSR eng' aplikesheni neng'ung'.

english: Payments, fees and other accounts questions.
kiswahili: Malipo, ada na maswali mengine ya hesabu.
translation: Lipanet, robinik ab sukul ak teebutik alak agobo rabinik.

english: Masomo Welfare, Magister Sacco and the day-to-day running of the office.
kiswahili: Masomo Welfare, Magister Sacco na uendeshaji wa kila siku wa ofisi.
translation: Masomo Welfare, Magister Sacco ak boisiet ab ofisit ab betut age tugul.

english: IELTS and PTE classes, and learning German.
kiswahili: Madarasa ya IELTS na PTE, na kujifunza Kijerumani.
translation: Kilasisiek ab IELTS ak PTE, ak somanet ab Kijerumani.

english: A welcome at reception, and pointing you to the right person.
kiswahili: Makaribisho mapokezi, na kukuelekeza kwa mtu sahihi.
translation: Kichamgei inyee eng' reception, ak kiboorun chii ne nyolu.

english: Point at a department to see who works there and how they help you.
kiswahili: Elekeza kipanya kwenye idara kuona anayefanya kazi huko na jinsi wanavyokusaidia.
translation: Nyil idara si ikeer chii ne boisie emonoton ak ole kotoretin.

kiswahili: Washauri walio nyuma ya ombi lako.

english: From our office in Eldoret, and online for students across Kenya, our team works with you personally from your first meeting until you arrive and start your studies abroad.
kiswahili: Kutoka ofisi yetu Eldoret, na mtandaoni kwa wanafunzi kote Kenya, timu yetu hufanya kazi nawe kibinafsi kuanzia mkutano wako wa kwanza hadi unapofika na kuanza masomo yako ughaibuni.
translation: Kong'eten ofisit nenyo ab Eldoret, ak online ab kipsomaninik eng' Kenya tugul, timit nenyo koboisie ak inyee kong'eten tuiyet neng'ung' ne tai agoi iit ak itaun somanet neng'ung' eng' sang' ab emet.

english: We are putting together guides for students planning to study abroad. Check back soon.
kiswahili: Tunaandaa miongozo kwa wanafunzi wanaopanga kusoma nje ya nchi. Rudi baadaye.
translation: Kichobei ng'alek che indoi kipsomaninik che chobei somanet eng' sang' ab emet. Iweech kasarta ne ma koi.
Sobet ab kipsomaniat eng' sang' ab emet

english: To facilitate access to quality education abroad for Kenyan students, ensuring affordability, transparency, and personalised support throughout their academic journey.
kiswahili: Kuwezesha upatikanaji wa elimu bora ughaibuni kwa wanafunzi wa Kenya, kuhakikisha unafuu, uwazi na usaidizi wa kibinafsi katika safari yao yote ya masomo.
translation: Kotoret kipsomaninik ab Kenya konyor somanet ne kararan eng' sang' ab emet, eng' olyet ne nyolu, eng' imanit ak eng' toretet ne nyolu chii age tugul eng' oret nenyin tugul ab somanet.

english: Affordable options so cost does not stand in the way of education.
kiswahili: Chaguo nafuu ili gharama isiwe kikwazo cha elimu.
translation: Oratinwek che olyet ne ming'in si ma koter robinik somanet.

english: Keeping up with new trends, tools and best practice in international education.
kiswahili: Kufuatilia mielekeo mipya, zana na mbinu bora katika elimu ya kimataifa.
translation: Konai tuguk che lel, kerkeinik ak oratinwek che kararan eng' somanet ab emotinwek alak.

english: Rigorous checks that protect students and partners alike.
kiswahili: Ukaguzi mkali unaowalinda wanafunzi na washirika kwa pamoja.
translation: Keret ne kiyaei komie missing ne ripei kipsomaninik ak sukulisiek che kiboisie ak acheek.

english: 79 partner institutions in Sydney, including Abbey College Australia, Acknowledge Education and AHHI.
kiswahili: Taasisi 79 washirika huko Sydney, zikiwemo Abbey College Australia, Acknowledge Education na AHHI.
translation: Sukulisiek 79 che kiboisie ak acheek eng' Sydney, kobooto Abbey College Australia, Acknowledge Education ak AHHI.

english: 58 partner institutions in Melbourne, including Acknowledge Education, AIBI Higher Education and Alphacrucis University College.
kiswahili: Taasisi 58 washirika huko Melbourne, zikiwemo Acknowledge Education, AIBI Higher Education na Alphacrucis University College.
translation: Sukulisiek 58 che kiboisie ak acheek eng' Melbourne, kobooto Acknowledge Education, AIBI Higher Education ak Alphacrucis University College.

english: 28 partner institutions in Brisbane, including Acknowledge Education, AIBI Higher Education and Alphacrucis University College.
kiswahili: Taasisi 28 washirika huko Brisbane, zikiwemo Acknowledge Education, AIBI Higher Education na Alphacrucis University College.
translation: Sukulisiek 28 che kiboisie ak acheek eng' Brisbane, kobooto Acknowledge Education, AIBI Higher Education ak Alphacrucis University College.

english: 26 partner institutions in Perth, including Acknowledge Education, AIBI Higher Education and Alphacrucis University College.
kiswahili: Taasisi 26 washirika huko Perth, zikiwemo Acknowledge Education, AIBI Higher Education na Alphacrucis University College.
translation: Sukulisiek 26 che kiboisie ak acheek eng' Perth, kobooto Acknowledge Education, AIBI Higher Education ak Alphacrucis University College.

english: 22 partner institutions in Adelaide, including Abbey College Australia, Acknowledge Education and Alphacrucis University College.
kiswahili: Taasisi 22 washirika huko Adelaide, zikiwemo Abbey College Australia, Acknowledge Education na Alphacrucis University College.
translation: Sukulisiek 22 che kiboisie ak acheek eng' Adelaide, kobooto Abbey College Australia, Acknowledge Education ak Alphacrucis University College.

english: Our counsellors can advise on study options in Gold Coast.
kiswahili: Washauri wetu wanaweza kushauri kuhusu chaguo za masomo huko Gold Coast.
translation: Imuchi kirwogik chenyo koboorun oratinwek ab somanet eng' Gold Coast.

english: 5 partner institutions in Canberra, including Australian Catholic University, Australian National University and Canberra Institute of Technology.
kiswahili: Taasisi 5 washirika huko Canberra, zikiwemo Australian Catholic University, Australian National University na Canberra Institute of Technology.
translation: Sukulisiek 5 che kiboisie ak acheek eng' Canberra, kobooto Australian Catholic University, Australian National University ak Canberra Institute of Technology.

english: 2 partner institutions in Darwin: Canterbury Institute of Management and Charles Darwin University (CDU).
kiswahili: Taasisi 2 washirika huko Darwin: Canterbury Institute of Management na Charles Darwin University (CDU).
translation: Sukulisiek 2 che kiboisie ak acheek eng' Darwin: Canterbury Institute of Management ak Charles Darwin University (CDU).

english: 5 partner institutions in Hobart, including Australia Institute of Business and Technology (AIBT), Australian Vocational Training Academy (AVTA) and Reach Community College.
kiswahili: Taasisi 5 washirika huko Hobart, zikiwemo Australia Institute of Business and Technology (AIBT), Australian Vocational Training Academy (AVTA) na Reach Community College.
translation: Sukulisiek 5 che kiboisie ak acheek eng' Hobart, kobooto Australia Institute of Business and Technology (AIBT), Australian Vocational Training Academy (AVTA) ak Reach Community College.

english: Our counsellors can advise on study options in Townsville.
kiswahili: Washauri wetu wanaweza kushauri kuhusu chaguo za masomo huko Townsville.
translation: Imuchi kirwogik chenyo koboorun oratinwek ab somanet eng' Townsville.

english: Home to the iconic Sydney Opera House, a UNESCO World Heritage Site with over one million roof tiles.
kiswahili: Nyumbani kwa Sydney Opera House maarufu, Eneo la Urithi wa Dunia la UNESCO lenye zaidi ya vigae milioni moja vya paa.
translation: Ole mi Sydney Opera House ne kigen eng' ng'wony, ole ne kiripei UNESCO (World Heritage Site) ne tinye tiles kosiir milioni agenge eng' barak.

english: Long ranked among the world's most liveable cities, known for its laneway cafés and arts scene.
kiswahili: Kwa muda mrefu imekuwa miongoni mwa miji inayofaa zaidi kuishi duniani, inayojulikana kwa mikahawa yake ya vichochoro na sanaa.
translation: Kakigeer kasarta ne koi kou agenge eng' taunisiek che kararan missing eng' sobet eng' ng'wony, ne kigen amu cafés eng' oratinwek che ming'in ak tuguk ab sanaa.

english: Australia's third most populous city, set on the winding Brisbane River.
kiswahili: Jiji la tatu kwa idadi ya watu Australia, lililo kando ya Mto Brisbane unaopinda.
translation: Taunit ne bo somok eng' Australia ne tinye biik chechang' missing, ne mi kobo Oinet ab Brisbane.

english: One of the most geographically isolated major cities in the world, with vast desert to its east.
kiswahili: Mojawapo ya miji mikubwa iliyotengwa zaidi kijiografia duniani, ikiwa na jangwa kubwa mashariki yake.
translation: Agenge eng' taunisiek che echen eng' ng'wony che mi ole ne ma mi taunisiek alak negit, ne tinye surkwen ne oo eng' kong'asis.

english: Known as the "City of Churches," with more places of worship per capita than any other Australian city.
kiswahili: Inajulikana kama "Jiji la Makanisa", ikiwa na nyumba nyingi za ibada kwa kila mtu kuliko jiji lolote la Australia.
translation: Kigure "Taunit ab Kanisosyek", amu tinye kanisosyek chechang' kosiir taunit age tugul eng' Australia, ye kegeer biik che mi.

english: Famous for its golden beaches and Australia's largest cluster of theme parks.
kiswahili: Maarufu kwa fukwe zake za dhahabu na kundi kubwa zaidi la mbuga za burudani Australia.
translation: Kigen amu beaches che u dhahabu ak theme parks che chang' missing eng' Australia.

english: Chosen in 1908 as a purpose-built capital, a compromise between rival cities Sydney and Melbourne.
kiswahili: Lilichaguliwa mwaka 1908 kuwa mji mkuu uliojengwa kwa makusudi, suluhisho kati ya miji pinzani ya Sydney na Melbourne.
translation: Kilewen eng' 1908 kou taunit ne oo ne kichob amu kiy noton, si kotar ng'olyon ne ki mi kwenutab Sydney ak Melbourne.

english: Australia's tropical capital of the north, closer to Jakarta than to Canberra.
kiswahili: Mji mkuu wa kitropiki wa kaskazini mwa Australia, ulio karibu zaidi na Jakarta kuliko Canberra.
translation: Taunit ne oo ab kaskazini ab Australia ne bo kiptoret, ne mi negit Jakarta kosiir Canberra.

english: Australia's second-oldest capital city, founded in 1804 on the Derwent River.
kiswahili: Mji mkuu wa pili kwa ukongwe Australia, ulioanzishwa mwaka 1804 kando ya Mto Derwent.
translation: Taunit ne oo ne bo aeng' eng' keny eng' Australia, ne kitaun eng' 1804 kobo Oinet ab Derwent.

english: A tropical city in North Queensland, home to James Cook University and the gateway to the Great Barrier Reef and Magnetic Island.
kiswahili: Jiji la kitropiki Queensland Kaskazini, nyumbani kwa Chuo Kikuu cha James Cook na lango la Great Barrier Reef na Kisiwa cha Magnetic.
translation: Taunit ne bo kiptoret eng' North Queensland, ole mi James Cook University ak kurgeet ab Great Barrier Reef ak Magnetic Island.

english: World-class universities and a relaxed, multicultural lifestyle. We guide you from application to arrival.
kiswahili: Vyuo vikuu vya kiwango cha dunia na maisha tulivu yenye tamaduni nyingi. Tunakuongoza kutoka kuomba hadi kufika.
translation: Univasitisiek che bo tai eng' ng'wony ak sobet ne tinye kaalyeet ne tinye biik ab ortinwek chechang'. Kiindochin kong'eten aplikesheni agoi ye kakiit.
Keer ngo imuchi isomane eng' Australia

english: A wide range of internationally recognised degree programs across every discipline.
kiswahili: Aina nyingi za shahada zinazotambuliwa kimataifa katika kila taaluma.
translation: Degrisiek chechang' che kiyan eng' ng'wony tugul eng' oratinwek tugul ab somanet.

english: Many courses combine classroom learning with practical, hands-on training.
kiswahili: Kozi nyingi huchanganya masomo ya darasani na mafunzo ya vitendo.
translation: Kosisiek chechang' kotuiyei somanet ab kilasit ak boisiet ab eunek.

english: Welcoming, diverse communities with a high standard of living.
kiswahili: Jamii zenye ukarimu na utofauti, zenye kiwango cha juu cha maisha.
translation: Biik che tinye chamyet ak che bunu ortinwek chechang', ne tinye sobet ne kararan missing.

english: You apply for a Student visa (subclass 500) once your education provider issues your Confirmation of Enrolment (CoE). You must also meet the Genuine Student requirement, hold Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC) for your whole stay, show you can pay for your tuition and living costs, and give an accepted English test result such as IELTS or PTE.
kiswahili: Unaomba Visa ya mwanafunzi (subclass 500) mara taasisi yako ya elimu inapokupa Uthibitisho wa Kujiandikisha (CoE). Lazima pia utimize sharti la Mwanafunzi Halisi, uwe na Bima ya Afya ya Wanafunzi wa Kigeni (OSHC) kwa muda wote wa kukaa kwako, uonyeshe unaweza kulipa ada na gharama za maisha, na utoe matokeo ya mtihani wa Kiingereza unaokubalika kama IELTS au PTE.
translation: Isomei Student visa (subclass 500) ye kakogochin sukul neng'ung' Confirmation of Enrolment (CoE). Imache kora iyai Genuine Student requirement, itinye Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC) eng' kasarta tugul ne imi emonoton, iboru ile imuchi ilipan robinik ab sukul ak robinik ab sobet, ak igochi result ab tiemutik ab Kiingereza ne kiyan, kou IELTS anan PTE.

english: Current visa subclass, fees and financial thresholds are set by the Australian government and change from time to time.
kiswahili: Aina ya sasa ya visa, ada na viwango vya fedha huwekwa na serikali ya Australia na hubadilika mara kwa mara.
translation: Visa subclass ne mi raini, robinik ab visa ak robinik che imache iboru kochobei serikali ab Australia, ak kowalaksei kasarta ak kasarta.
Cheng' eng' kainet ab sukul anan kozi

english: World-class universities and a relaxed, multicultural lifestyle.
kiswahili: Vyuo vikuu vya hadhi ya dunia na maisha tulivu ya tamaduni mbalimbali.
translation: Univasitisiek che bo tai eng' ng'wony ak sobet ne tinye kaalyeet ne tinye biik ab ortinwek chechang'.

english: No language barrier for Kenyan students entering the classroom.
kiswahili: Hakuna kizuizi cha lugha kwa wanafunzi wa Kenya wanapoingia darasani.
translation: Ma mi ng'olyon ab kutit eng' kipsomaninik ab Kenya ye chutei kilasit.
Taunisiek che tinye biik ab ortinwek chechang'

english: Ready to start your journey abroad?
kiswahili: Uko tayari kuanza safari yako ughaibuni?
translation: Tos kaichobgei itaun oredeng'ung' eng' sang' ab emet?

english: Book a free consultation with our counsellors today.
kiswahili: Omba ushauri bila malipo na washauri wetu leo.
translation: Som kirwoget ne ma kelipani ak kirwogik chenyo raini.

english: Our counsellors can advise on study options in Toronto.
kiswahili: Washauri wetu wanaweza kushauri kuhusu chaguo za masomo huko Toronto.
translation: Imuchi kirwogik chenyo koboorun oratinwek ab somanet eng' Toronto.

english: 1 partner institution in Vancouver: Oxford International Education Group.
kiswahili: Taasisi 1 mshirika huko Vancouver: Oxford International Education Group.
translation: Sukul agenge ne kiboisie ak acheek eng' Vancouver: Oxford International Education Group.

english: Our counsellors can advise on study options in Montreal.
kiswahili: Washauri wetu wanaweza kushauri kuhusu chaguo za masomo huko Montreal.
translation: Imuchi kirwogik chenyo koboorun oratinwek ab somanet eng' Montreal.

english: Our counsellors can advise on study options in Ottawa.
kiswahili: Washauri wetu wanaweza kushauri kuhusu chaguo za masomo huko Ottawa.
translation: Imuchi kirwogik chenyo koboorun oratinwek ab somanet eng' Ottawa.

english: Our counsellors can advise on study options in Calgary.
kiswahili: Washauri wetu wanaweza kushauri kuhusu chaguo za masomo huko Calgary.
translation: Imuchi kirwogik chenyo koboorun oratinwek ab somanet eng' Calgary.

english: Our counsellors can advise on study options in Edmonton.
kiswahili: Washauri wetu wanaweza kushauri kuhusu chaguo za masomo huko Edmonton.
translation: Imuchi kirwogik chenyo koboorun oratinwek ab somanet eng' Edmonton.

english: 1 partner institution in Winnipeg: University of Manitoba.
kiswahili: Taasisi 1 mshirika huko Winnipeg: University of Manitoba.
translation: Sukul agenge ne kiboisie ak acheek eng' Winnipeg: University of Manitoba.

english: 1 partner institution in Halifax: Oxford International Education Group.
kiswahili: Taasisi 1 mshirika huko Halifax: Oxford International Education Group.
translation: Sukul agenge ne kiboisie ak acheek eng' Halifax: Oxford International Education Group.

english: 1 partner institution in Saskatoon: Saskatchewan Polytechnic.
kiswahili: Taasisi 1 mshirika huko Saskatoon: Saskatchewan Polytechnic.
translation: Sukul agenge ne kiboisie ak acheek eng' Saskatoon: Saskatchewan Polytechnic.

english: Canada's largest city, home to the 553-metre CN Tower, the world's tallest free-standing structure for more than 30 years.
kiswahili: Jiji kubwa zaidi la Kanada, nyumbani kwa CN Tower ya mita 553, jengo refu zaidi duniani linalojisimamia kwa zaidi ya miaka 30.
translation: Taunit ne oo missing eng' Kanada, ole mi CN Tower ne koi mita 553, kaa ne ki koi missing eng' ng'wony eng' kenyisiek kosiir 30.

english: Regularly ranked among the world's most liveable cities, set between the Pacific Ocean and the Coast Mountains.
kiswahili: Mara nyingi hupangwa miongoni mwa miji inayofaa zaidi kuishi duniani, lililo kati ya Bahari ya Pasifiki na Milima ya Pwani.
translation: Kegeer kasarta ak kasarta kou agenge eng' taunisiek che kararan missing eng' sobet eng' ng'wony, ne mi kwenutab Pacific Ocean ak Coast Mountains.

english: One of the world's largest French-speaking cities, built around Mount Royal, the hill it takes its name from.
kiswahili: Mojawapo ya miji mikubwa zaidi duniani inayozungumza Kifaransa, iliyojengwa kuzunguka Mount Royal, kilima kilichoipa jina lake.
translation: Agenge eng' taunisiek che echen missing eng' ng'wony che ng'alalei Kifaransa, ne kichob kogole Mount Royal, tulwet ne kigoon kainet.

english: Canada's capital, home to Parliament Hill and a Rideau Canal that becomes the world's largest naturally frozen skating rink each winter.
kiswahili: Mji mkuu wa Kanada, nyumbani kwa Parliament Hill na Mfereji wa Rideau unaogeuka kuwa uwanja mkubwa zaidi duniani wa barafu ya asili ya kuteleza kila majira ya baridi.
translation: Taunit ne oo ab serikali ab Kanada, ole mi Parliament Hill ak Rideau Canal ne walaksei koek ole ne oo missing eng' ng'wony ne kiwendoi eng' barafu eng' kasarta ab kaitit age tugul.

english: Host of the 1988 Winter Olympics and the annual Calgary Stampede, with the Canadian Rockies close by.
kiswahili: Mwenyeji wa Michezo ya Olimpiki ya Majira ya Baridi ya 1988 na Calgary Stampede ya kila mwaka, ikiwa karibu na Milima ya Rocky ya Kanada.
translation: Ki kiyai eng' yu Winter Olympics ab 1988, ak kiyaei Calgary Stampede kenyit age tugul; ak Canadian Rockies ko mi negit.

english: Alberta's capital, known as the "Festival City" and home to West Edmonton Mall, the largest shopping mall in North America.
kiswahili: Mji mkuu wa Alberta, unaojulikana kama "Jiji la Sherehe" na nyumbani kwa West Edmonton Mall, duka kubwa zaidi la maduka Amerika Kaskazini.
translation: Taunit ne oo ab serikali ab Alberta, ne kigure "Festival City", ole mi West Edmonton Mall, duka ne oo missing eng' North America.

english: The capital of Manitoba, built where the Red and Assiniboine rivers meet at The Forks, a gathering place for thousands of years and now home to the Canadian Museum for Human Rights.
kiswahili: Mji mkuu wa Manitoba, uliojengwa mahali Mito ya Red na Assiniboine inapokutana kwenye The Forks, mahali pa mikutano kwa maelfu ya miaka na sasa nyumbani kwa Canadian Museum for Human Rights.
translation: Taunit ne oo ab serikali ab Manitoba, ne kichob ole tuiyei oinosiek ab Red ak Assiniboine eng' The Forks, ole ne ki tuiyei biik eng' kenyisiek eliphuusyek, ak raini ko mi Canadian Museum for Human Rights.

english: Nova Scotia's capital and the largest city in Atlantic Canada, a harbour city overlooked by the star-shaped Citadel fortress and home to Dalhousie University.
kiswahili: Mji mkuu wa Nova Scotia na jiji kubwa zaidi la Kanada ya Atlantiki, jiji la bandari linalotazamwa na ngome ya Citadel yenye umbo la nyota na nyumbani kwa Chuo Kikuu cha Dalhousie.
translation: Taunit ne oo ab serikali ab Nova Scotia ak taunit ne oo missing eng' Atlantic Canada, taunit ab bandari ne keerei Citadel (fort ne u kokeliet) ak ole mi Dalhousie University.

english: Known as the "City of Bridges" for the spans across the South Saskatchewan River, and home to the University of Saskatchewan.
kiswahili: Linajulikana kama "Jiji la Madaraja" kwa madaraja juu ya Mto South Saskatchewan, na nyumbani kwa Chuo Kikuu cha Saskatchewan.
translation: Kigure "City of Bridges" amu bridges chechang' che mi barak ab South Saskatchewan River, ak ole mi University of Saskatchewan.
Degrisiek che kiyan eng' ng'wony tugul

english: Recognised qualifications across every field of study.
translation: Sertifiketisiek ak degrisiek che kiyan eng' oratinwek tugul ab somanet.

english: Choose between career-focused college diplomas and university degrees.
