english: Germany's capital and largest city, reunified in 1990 and now one of Europe's leading centres for startups and the arts.
kiswahili: Mji mkuu na jiji kubwa zaidi la Ujerumani, ulioungana tena mwaka 1990 na sasa mojawapo ya vituo vikuu vya Ulaya vya biashara changa na sanaa.
translation: Taunit ne oo ab serikali ak taunit ne oo missing eng' Ujerumani, ne kiwechi kotuiyo eng' 1990, ak raini ko agenge eng' taunisiek che bo tai eng' Ulaya agobo kampunisiek che lel ak sanaa.

english: Bavaria's capital, home to the world-famous Oktoberfest and some of Germany's top-ranked technical universities.
kiswahili: Mji mkuu wa Bavaria, nyumbani kwa Oktoberfest maarufu duniani na baadhi ya vyuo vikuu vya ufundi vilivyo juu zaidi Ujerumani.
translation: Taunit ne oo ab Bavaria, ole kiyaei Oktoberfest ne kigen eng' ng'wony tugul, ak ole mi univasitisiek alak ab teknoloji che bo tai missing eng' Ujerumani.

english: Germany's second-largest city and a major port, built around more canals and bridges than Amsterdam and Venice combined.
kiswahili: Jiji la pili kwa ukubwa Ujerumani na bandari kuu, lenye mifereji na madaraja mengi kuliko Amsterdam na Venice kwa pamoja.
translation: Taunit ne oo ne bo aeng' eng' Ujerumani ak bandari ne oo, ne tinye canals ak bridges kosiir Amsterdam ak Venice ye kituiyo.

english: Continental Europe's financial capital, home to the European Central Bank and one of the world's busiest airports.
kiswahili: Mji mkuu wa fedha wa Ulaya Bara, nyumbani kwa Benki Kuu ya Ulaya na mojawapo ya viwanja vya ndege vyenye shughuli nyingi zaidi duniani.
translation: Taunit ab rabinik ab Ulaya (Continental Europe), ole mi European Central Bank ak agenge eng' airports che tinye boisiet ne oo missing eng' ng'wony.

english: Home to Mercedes-Benz and Porsche, at the heart of Germany's automotive and engineering industry.
kiswahili: Nyumbani kwa Mercedes-Benz na Porsche, katikati ya tasnia ya magari na uhandisi ya Ujerumani.
translation: Ole mi Mercedes-Benz ak Porsche, eng' mukulelto ab boisiet ab garisiek ak engineering eng' Ujerumani.

english: A fashion and trade-fair hub on the Rhine, home to one of Europe's largest Japanese communities.
kiswahili: Kitovu cha mitindo na maonyesho ya biashara kando ya Mto Rhine, nyumbani kwa mojawapo ya jamii kubwa zaidi za Wajapani Ulaya.
translation: Taunit ab fashion ak trade fairs ne mi kobo Oinet ab Rhine, ole mi agenge eng' tuiyosiek che echen missing ab biik ab Japan eng' Ulaya.

english: A historic centre of music and publishing, once home to Johann Sebastian Bach and now a fast-growing student city.
kiswahili: Kituo cha kihistoria cha muziki na uchapishaji, ambacho zamani kilikuwa nyumbani kwa Johann Sebastian Bach na sasa ni jiji la wanafunzi linalokua haraka.
translation: Taunit ne bo keny ab muziki ak publishing, ole ki mi Johann Sebastian Bach, ak raini ko taunit ab kipsomaninik ne kiit chokyi.

english: One of Germany's oldest port cities, famously the setting of the Brothers Grimm tale "The Town Musicians of Bremen".
kiswahili: Mojawapo ya miji ya bandari ya zamani zaidi Ujerumani, maarufu kama mahali pa hadithi ya Ndugu Grimm "Wanamuziki wa Mji wa Bremen".
translation: Agenge eng' taunisiek ab bandari che bo keny missing eng' Ujerumani, ne kigen amu ng'alek ab Brothers Grimm "The Town Musicians of Bremen".

english: Home to Cologne Cathedral, a UNESCO World Heritage Site that took more than 600 years to complete, on the banks of the Rhine.
kiswahili: Nyumbani kwa Kanisa Kuu la Cologne, Eneo la Urithi wa Dunia la UNESCO lililochukua zaidi ya miaka 600 kukamilika, kando ya Mto Rhine.
translation: Ole mi Cologne Cathedral, ole ne kiripei UNESCO (World Heritage Site) ne ki nam kenyisiek kosiir 600 si kotar, kobo Oinet ab Rhine.

english: A former coal and steel city reinvented as a technology hub, home to TU Dortmund University and the football club Borussia Dortmund.
kiswahili: Zamani jiji la makaa ya mawe na chuma lililobadilishwa kuwa kitovu cha teknolojia, nyumbani kwa Chuo Kikuu cha TU Dortmund na klabu ya mpira Borussia Dortmund.
translation: Taunit ne ki kigen amu makaa ak chuma, ne kakowalaksei koek taunit ab teknoloji, ole mi TU Dortmund University ak timit ab mpira Borussia Dortmund.

english: Home to Germany's oldest university, founded in 1386, in a river valley beneath a ruined hilltop castle.
kiswahili: Nyumbani kwa chuo kikuu kikongwe zaidi Ujerumani, kilichoanzishwa mwaka 1386, katika bonde la mto chini ya ngome iliyoharibika juu ya kilima.
translation: Ole mi univasiti ne bo keny missing eng' Ujerumani, ne kitaun eng' 1386, eng' kiwotet ab oinet ne mi ng'wony ab ngomet ne kakowech barak ab tulwet.
Robinik ab sukul che ming'in anan ma tinye

english: Most public universities charge little to no tuition for degree programs.
kiswahili: Vyuo vikuu vingi vya umma hutoza ada ndogo sana au hakuna kwa programu za shahada.
translation: Univasitisiek chechang' ab serikali koteebe robinik ab sukul che ming'in missing anan ma teebe eng' programisiek ab degrii.

english: A long-standing international reputation in technical and scientific fields.
kiswahili: Sifa ya kimataifa ya muda mrefu katika nyanja za ufundi na sayansi.
translation: Kainet ne kararan ne bo keny eng' ng'wony eng' teknoloji ak sayansi.

english: Alongside German-taught degrees, many master's programmes are taught in English.
kiswahili: Pamoja na shahada zinazofundishwa kwa Kijerumani, programu nyingi za uzamili hufundishwa kwa Kiingereza.
translation: Kobooto degrisiek che kineti eng' Kijerumani, programisiek chechang' ab master's kineti eng' Kiingereza.

english: Easy access to travel, exchanges and research across the continent.
kiswahili: Urahisi wa kusafiri, kubadilishana na utafiti kote bara.
translation: Imuchi iwendi chokyi, ikweny somanet ak iyai utafiti eng' Ulaya tugul.

english: With a letter of admission from a German university you apply for a national (long-stay) student visa. You need proof that you can pay your living costs, usually through a blocked account, health insurance, and proof of the language your course is taught in: for German-taught courses usually B2 level or above (TestDaF or DSH), which is what our German Language Training prepares you for.
kiswahili: Ukiwa na barua ya kukubaliwa kutoka chuo kikuu cha Ujerumani, unaomba visa ya kitaifa (ya muda mrefu) ya mwanafunzi. Unahitaji uthibitisho kwamba unaweza kulipa gharama za maisha, kwa kawaida kupitia akaunti iliyofungwa, bima ya afya, na uthibitisho wa lugha ambayo kozi yako inafundishwa: kwa kozi zinazofundishwa kwa Kijerumani kwa kawaida kiwango cha B2 au zaidi (TestDaF au DSH), ambacho Mafunzo yetu ya Lugha ya Kijerumani yanakuandaa nacho.
translation: Ye itinye baruet ne mwoe ile kakiyan inyee kong'eten univasiti ab Ujerumani, isomei national (long-stay) student visa. Imache iboru ile imuchi ilipan robinik ab sobet, chechang' eng' blocked account, ak bima ab konyoiset, ak iboru kutit ne kineti kozi neng'ung': eng' kosisiek che kineti eng' Kijerumani, chechang' ko kiwendi ab B2 anan kosiir (TestDaF anan DSH), ne noton ko ne kochobin Somanet nenyo ab Kijerumani (German Language Training).

english: Current visa fees and blocked-account thresholds are set by German authorities and change from time to time.
kiswahili: Ada za sasa za visa na viwango vya akaunti iliyofungwa huwekwa na mamlaka za Ujerumani na hubadilika mara kwa mara.
translation: Robinik ab visa che mi raini ak robinik che imache itinye eng' blocked account kochobei biik ab serikali ab Ujerumani, ak kowalaksei kasarta ak kasarta.
Natural Sciences (Sayansi ab Tuguk ab Ng'wony)

english: Respected colleges and universities in a safe, welcoming, multicultural country.
kiswahili: Vyuo na vyuo vikuu vinavyoheshimika katika nchi salama, ya kukaribisha na yenye tamaduni nyingi.
translation: Kolejisiek ak univasitisiek che kiboiboitu eng' emet ne tinye kaalyeet, ne tinye chamyet ak biik ab ortinwek chechang'.

english: Our counsellors can advise on study options in Dublin.
kiswahili: Washauri wetu wanaweza kushauri kuhusu chaguo za masomo huko Dublin.
translation: Imuchi kirwogik chenyo koboorun oratinwek ab somanet eng' Dublin.

english: Our counsellors can advise on study options in Cork.
kiswahili: Washauri wetu wanaweza kushauri kuhusu chaguo za masomo huko Cork.
translation: Imuchi kirwogik chenyo koboorun oratinwek ab somanet eng' Cork.

english: Our counsellors can advise on study options in Galway.
kiswahili: Washauri wetu wanaweza kushauri kuhusu chaguo za masomo huko Galway.
translation: Imuchi kirwogik chenyo koboorun oratinwek ab somanet eng' Galway.

english: Our counsellors can advise on study options in Limerick.
kiswahili: Washauri wetu wanaweza kushauri kuhusu chaguo za masomo huko Limerick.
translation: Imuchi kirwogik chenyo koboorun oratinwek ab somanet eng' Limerick.

english: Our counsellors can advise on study options in Waterford.
kiswahili: Washauri wetu wanaweza kushauri kuhusu chaguo za masomo huko Waterford.
translation: Imuchi kirwogik chenyo koboorun oratinwek ab somanet eng' Waterford.

english: Our counsellors can advise on study options in Belfast.
kiswahili: Washauri wetu wanaweza kushauri kuhusu chaguo za masomo huko Belfast.
translation: Imuchi kirwogik chenyo koboorun oratinwek ab somanet eng' Belfast.

english: Our counsellors can advise on study options in Derry.
kiswahili: Washauri wetu wanaweza kushauri kuhusu chaguo za masomo huko Derry.
translation: Imuchi kirwogik chenyo koboorun oratinwek ab somanet eng' Derry.

english: EU-recognised degrees in a welcoming, English-speaking country.
kiswahili: Shahada zinazotambuliwa na EU katika nchi yenye ukarimu inayozungumza Kiingereza.
translation: Degrisiek che kiyan eng' EU eng' emet ne tinye chamyet ne ng'alalei Kiingereza.

english: Ireland's capital and largest city, home to Trinity College Dublin (founded in 1592) and the European headquarters of many global technology companies.
kiswahili: Mji mkuu na jiji kubwa zaidi la Ireland, nyumbani kwa Trinity College Dublin (kilichoanzishwa 1592) na makao makuu ya Ulaya ya kampuni nyingi za kimataifa za teknolojia.
translation: Taunit ne oo ab serikali ak taunit ne oo missing eng' Ayalandi, ole mi Trinity College Dublin (ne kitaun eng' 1592) ak ofisisiek che echen ab Ulaya ab kampunisiek chechang' ab teknoloji ab ng'wony.

english: The Republic's second-largest city, with a historic centre on an island in the River Lee and one of the world's largest natural harbours nearby.
kiswahili: Jiji la pili kwa ukubwa la Jamhuri, lenye kituo cha kihistoria kwenye kisiwa katika Mto Lee na mojawapo ya bandari kubwa zaidi za asili duniani karibu.
translation: Taunit ne oo ne bo aeng' eng' Republic of Ireland, ne tinye ole ne bo keny eng' kisiwa eng' River Lee ak agenge eng' bandarisiek che echen missing che mi kou ne kichob ng'wony, ne mi negit.

english: The "City of the Tribes" on Ireland's Atlantic coast, home to the University of Galway and a European Capital of Culture for 2020.
kiswahili: "Jiji la Makabila" kwenye pwani ya Atlantiki ya Ireland, nyumbani kwa Chuo Kikuu cha Galway na Mji Mkuu wa Utamaduni wa Ulaya mwaka 2020.
translation: "Taunit ab Ortinwek" (City of the Tribes) ne mi kobo Atlantic eng' Ayalandi, ole mi University of Galway, ak ki kou European Capital of Culture eng' 2020.

english: Set on the River Shannon and home to the 13th-century King John's Castle, which has stood over the river for more than 800 years.
kiswahili: Lililo kando ya Mto Shannon na nyumbani kwa Ngome ya King John ya karne ya 13, iliyosimama juu ya mto kwa zaidi ya miaka 800.
translation: Ne mi kobo River Shannon, ole mi King John's Castle ne kichob eng' kenyisiek pogol 13 (13th century), ne kakotonon kobo oinet eng' kenyisiek kosiir 800.

english: Ireland's oldest city, founded by Vikings in 914 and famous around the world for Waterford Crystal.
kiswahili: Jiji kongwe zaidi la Ireland, lililoanzishwa na Wavikingi mwaka 914 na maarufu duniani kote kwa Waterford Crystal.
translation: Taunit ne bo keny missing eng' Ayalandi, ne kitaun eng' Vikings eng' 914, ak ne kigen eng' ng'wony tugul amu Waterford Crystal.

english: The capital of Northern Ireland (part of the UK), where the RMS Titanic was built, now home to the Titanic Belfast visitor experience.
kiswahili: Mji mkuu wa Ireland Kaskazini (sehemu ya Uingereza), ambako meli ya RMS Titanic ilijengwa, sasa ukiwa na kivutio cha wageni cha Titanic Belfast.
translation: Taunit ne oo ab serikali ab Northern Ireland (ne mi eng' UK), ole ki kichob RMS Titanic, ak raini ole mi Titanic Belfast ne kibunu biik che chomei.

english: Northern Ireland's second-largest city (part of the UK), with 17th-century walls that are the most complete city walls in Ireland.
kiswahili: Jiji la pili kwa ukubwa Ireland Kaskazini (sehemu ya Uingereza), lenye kuta za karne ya 17 ambazo ni kuta kamili zaidi za jiji nchini Ireland.
translation: Taunit ne oo ne bo aeng' eng' Northern Ireland (ne mi eng' UK), ne tinye irimeek ab 17th century che bo taunit che kararan missing eng' Ayalandi tugul.

english: Qualifications respected across Europe and internationally.
kiswahili: Sifa zinazoheshimika kote Ulaya na kimataifa.
translation: Sertifiketisiek ak degrisiek che kiboiboitu eng' Ulaya tugul ak eng' ng'wony.

english: Courses that draw on Ireland's strengths in technology, pharmaceuticals and research.
kiswahili: Kozi zinazotumia nguvu za Ireland katika teknolojia, dawa na utafiti.
translation: Kosisiek che boisie kimnatet ab Ayalandi eng' teknoloji, kerichek ak utafiti.
Ng'alek ab keny ak ortinwek che kararan

english: Centuries of heritage, music and storytelling to explore while you study.
kiswahili: Karne za urithi, muziki na usimulizi wa hadithi za kugundua ukiwa unasoma.
translation: Kenyisiek pogol chechang' ab tuguk ab keny, muziki ak ng'alek che imuchi ikeer ye isomane.

english: A welcoming student culture with no language barrier.
kiswahili: Utamaduni wa wanafunzi wenye ukarimu bila kizuizi cha lugha.
translation: Sobet ab kipsomaninik ne tinye chamyet ne ma mi ng'olyon ab kutit.

english: Your course must be on Ireland's list of eligible programmes. You apply for a long-stay (D) study visa with your letter of acceptance, proof that your fees are paid, proof of funds and private medical insurance, then register for your Stamp 2 student permission after you arrive.
kiswahili: Kozi yako lazima iwe kwenye orodha ya programu zinazostahili za Ireland. Unaomba visa ya masomo ya muda mrefu (D) ukiwa na barua yako ya kukubaliwa, uthibitisho kwamba ada zimelipwa, uthibitisho wa fedha na bima ya afya ya kibinafsi, kisha unasajili ruhusa yako ya mwanafunzi ya Stamp 2 baada ya kufika.
translation: Kozi neng'ung' komache komi eng' list ab Ayalandi ab programmes che kiyan. Isomei study visa ab long-stay (D) ak baruet neng'ung' ne mwoe ile kakiyan inyee, iboru ile kakilipan robinik ab sukul, iboru rabinik che itinye, ak private medical insurance; yeityo isir kaineng'ung' eng' Stamp 2 student permission ye kaiit.

english: Current visa fees and financial-evidence thresholds are set by Irish immigration authorities and change from time to time.
kiswahili: Ada za sasa za visa na viwango vya ushahidi wa fedha huwekwa na mamlaka za uhamiaji za Ireland na hubadilika mara kwa mara.
translation: Robinik ab visa che mi raini ak rabinik che imache iboru kochobei biik ab immigration ab Ayalandi, ak kowalaksei kasarta ak kasarta.

english: Our counsellors can advise on study options in Auckland.
kiswahili: Washauri wetu wanaweza kushauri kuhusu chaguo za masomo huko Auckland.
translation: Imuchi kirwogik chenyo koboorun oratinwek ab somanet eng' Auckland.

english: Our counsellors can advise on study options in Wellington.
kiswahili: Washauri wetu wanaweza kushauri kuhusu chaguo za masomo huko Wellington.
translation: Imuchi kirwogik chenyo koboorun oratinwek ab somanet eng' Wellington.

english: Our counsellors can advise on study options in Christchurch.
kiswahili: Washauri wetu wanaweza kushauri kuhusu chaguo za masomo huko Christchurch.
translation: Imuchi kirwogik chenyo koboorun oratinwek ab somanet eng' Christchurch.

english: Our counsellors can advise on study options in Hamilton.
kiswahili: Washauri wetu wanaweza kushauri kuhusu chaguo za masomo huko Hamilton.
translation: Imuchi kirwogik chenyo koboorun oratinwek ab somanet eng' Hamilton.

english: Our counsellors can advise on study options in Tauranga.
kiswahili: Washauri wetu wanaweza kushauri kuhusu chaguo za masomo huko Tauranga.
translation: Imuchi kirwogik chenyo koboorun oratinwek ab somanet eng' Tauranga.

english: Our counsellors can advise on study options in Dunedin.
kiswahili: Washauri wetu wanaweza kushauri kuhusu chaguo za masomo huko Dunedin.
translation: Imuchi kirwogik chenyo koboorun oratinwek ab somanet eng' Dunedin.

english: Ready to study in New Zealand?
kiswahili: Uko tayari kusoma nchini New Zealand?
translation: Tos kaichobgei isomane eng' New Zealand?

english: High-quality, practical education in a safe, welcoming country.
kiswahili: Elimu bora ya vitendo katika nchi salama yenye ukarimu.
translation: Somanet ne kararan ab boisiet ab eunek eng' emet ne tinye kaalyeet ak chamyet.

english: New Zealand's largest city, known as the "City of Sails" and built on a narrow isthmus between two harbours.
kiswahili: Jiji kubwa zaidi la New Zealand, linalojulikana kama "Jiji la Matanga" na lililojengwa juu ya shingo nyembamba ya ardhi kati ya bandari mbili.
translation: Taunit ne oo missing eng' New Zealand, ne kigure "City of Sails" ak ne kichob kobo ng'wony ne ming'in ne mi kwenutab bandarisiek aeng'.

english: New Zealand's capital and the world's southernmost national capital, known for its compact harbour setting and historic cable car.
kiswahili: Mji mkuu wa New Zealand na mji mkuu wa kitaifa wa kusini zaidi duniani, unaojulikana kwa mazingira yake madogo ya bandari na gari lake la kihistoria la kebo.
translation: Taunit ne oo ab serikali ab New Zealand ak taunit ne oo ab serikali ne mi kusini missing eng' ng'wony, ne kigen amu bandari nenyin ne ming'in ak cable car ne bo keny.

english: The largest city in the South Island, known as the "Garden City" and home to the University of Canterbury.
kiswahili: Jiji kubwa zaidi katika Kisiwa cha Kusini, linalojulikana kama "Jiji la Bustani" na nyumbani kwa Chuo Kikuu cha Canterbury.
translation: Taunit ne oo missing eng' South Island, ne kigure "Garden City" ak ole mi University of Canterbury.

english: Set on the Waikato River (New Zealand's longest) in a farming region, and home to the University of Waikato.
kiswahili: Lililo kando ya Mto Waikato (mrefu zaidi New Zealand) katika eneo la kilimo, na nyumbani kwa Chuo Kikuu cha Waikato.
translation: Ne mi kobo Waikato River (oinet ne koi missing eng' New Zealand) eng' emet ab mbarenik, ak ole mi University of Waikato.

english: A coastal Bay of Plenty city beneath Mauao (Mount Maunganui), home to the country's largest port by cargo volume.
kiswahili: Jiji la pwani la Bay of Plenty chini ya Mauao (Mount Maunganui), nyumbani kwa bandari kubwa zaidi nchini kwa kiasi cha mizigo.
translation: Taunit ab Bay of Plenty ne mi kobo ainet ab nyanjet, ne mi ng'wony ab Mauao (Mount Maunganui), ole mi bandari ne oo missing eng' emet ye kegeer tuguk che keyokte.

english: A student city with Scottish roots, home to the University of Otago, New Zealand's oldest university, founded in 1869.
kiswahili: Jiji la wanafunzi lenye mizizi ya Scotland, nyumbani kwa Chuo Kikuu cha Otago, chuo kikuu kongwe zaidi New Zealand, kilichoanzishwa mwaka 1869.
translation: Taunit ab kipsomaninik ne bunu Scotland, ole mi University of Otago, univasiti ne bo keny missing eng' New Zealand, ne kitaun eng' 1869.

english: A national quality framework and a government code of practice set the standard for how providers look after international students.
kiswahili: Mfumo wa kitaifa wa ubora na kanuni za maadili za serikali huweka kiwango cha jinsi watoa huduma wanavyowatunza wanafunzi wa kimataifa.
translation: Ng'atutik ab serikali ak kerichek ab boisiet kochobei ole ripei sukulisiek kipsomaninik che bunu emotinwek alak.

english: Courses that build practical skills, research ability and independent thinking.
kiswahili: Kozi zinazojenga ujuzi wa vitendo, uwezo wa utafiti na kufikiri kwa kujitegemea.
translation: Kosisiek che toretei chii konai boisiet ab eunek, koyai utafiti ak kokabwat eng' tuguk ineendet.
Biik che tinye kaalyeet ak chamyet

english: Regularly ranked among the most peaceful countries in the world.
kiswahili: Mara kwa mara huorodheshwa miongoni mwa nchi zenye amani zaidi duniani.
translation: Kegeer kasarta ak kasarta kou agenge eng' emotinwek che tinye kaalyeet missing eng' ng'wony.

english: You apply for a Fee Paying Student Visa with an offer of place from an approved education provider, proof that you can pay your tuition fees and living costs, and insurance your provider accepts. You may also be asked for health checks and, for longer stays, police certificates.
kiswahili: Unaomba Visa ya Mwanafunzi Anayelipa Ada ukiwa na ofa ya nafasi kutoka kwa mtoa elimu aliyeidhinishwa, uthibitisho kwamba unaweza kulipa ada za masomo na gharama za maisha, na bima inayokubaliwa na mtoa huduma wako. Unaweza pia kuombwa vipimo vya afya na, kwa kukaa kwa muda mrefu, vyeti vya polisi.
translation: Isomei Fee Paying Student Visa ak ofa ab kaburet kong'eten sukul ne kakiyan, iboru ile imuchi ilipan robinik ab sukul ak robinik ab sobet, ak bima ne yanei sukul neng'ung'. Imuchi kora keteebin health checks ak, ngo ibe kasarta ne koi, police certificates.

english: Current visa fees and financial-evidence thresholds are set by Immigration New Zealand and change from time to time.
kiswahili: Ada za sasa za visa na viwango vya ushahidi wa fedha huwekwa na Immigration New Zealand na hubadilika mara kwa mara.
translation: Robinik ab visa che mi raini ak robinik che imache iboru kochobei Immigration New Zealand, ak kowalaksei kasarta ak kasarta.
Agriculture & Horticulture (Kilimo ak Kilimo ab Bustani)

english: The link may be out of date, or the address may have a typo. These are the pages people look for most.
kiswahili: Kiungo kinaweza kuwa cha zamani, au anwani ina kosa la tahajia. Hizi ndizo kurasa ambazo watu hutafuta zaidi.
translation: Imuchi koek link ne bo keny, anan kotinye adres ng'olyon eng' kasiret. Chu ko ukurasaisiek che chengei biik chechang'.

english: Australia, the UK, Germany, Canada, Ireland and New Zealand.
kiswahili: Australia, Uingereza, Ujerumani, Kanada, Ayalandi na New Zealand.
translation: Australia, Uingereza, Ujerumani, Kanada, Ayalandi ak New Zealand.

english: Counselling, test prep, applications, visas and travel.
kiswahili: Ushauri, maandalizi ya mtihani, maombi, visa na safari.
translation: Kirwoget, chobet ab tiemutik, aplikesheni, visa ak rutoi.

english: Evelyne is the Director at Studies and Awards Limited, overseeing the organisation’s strategy and day-to-day operations.
kiswahili: Evelyne ni Mkurugenzi wa Studies and Awards Limited, anayesimamia mkakati na shughuli za kila siku za shirika.
translation: Evelyne ko Director eng' Studies and Awards Limited, ne ripei kabwaatutik ab kampuni ak boisiet ab betut age tugul.
Accounts and Human Resources (Rabinik ak Ng'alek ab Timit)

english: Evelyne Choge is the Director at Studies and Awards Limited, based in Eldoret. She sets the direction for how the team supports students across every stage of their study-abroad journey, from the first consultation through to departure.
kiswahili: Evelyne Choge ni Mkurugenzi wa Studies and Awards Limited, mwenye makao Eldoret. Huweka mwelekeo wa jinsi timu inavyowasaidia wanafunzi katika kila hatua ya safari yao ya kusoma nje, kuanzia ushauri wa kwanza hadi kuondoka.
translation: Evelyne Choge ko Director eng' Studies and Awards Limited, ne mi Eldoret. Kochobei oret ne toretei timit kipsomaninik eng' hatua age tugul ab oret nenywa ab somanet eng' sang' ab emet, kong'eten kirwoget ne tai agoi ye kamanda.

english: Evelyne works closely with each department to make sure students get consistent, personal guidance regardless of which destination or counsellor they’re paired with, and stays involved in the partnerships that keep the company’s advice current.
kiswahili: Evelyne hufanya kazi kwa karibu na kila idara kuhakikisha wanafunzi wanapata mwongozo thabiti na wa kibinafsi bila kujali nchi au mshauri waliyepangiwa, na hubaki kushiriki katika ushirikiano unaoweka ushauri wa kampuni wa kisasa.
translation: Evelyne koboisie negit ak idara age tugul si konyor kipsomaninik kirwoget ne kergei ak ne nyolu ineendet, agot ko lewen emet anan kirwogindet ainon, ak kotesei kotuiyo eng' kiboisiet ak kampunisiek alak ne toretei kirwoget ab kampuni koek ne lel.

english: Tina is the Personal Assistant to the Director at Studies and Awards Limited, supporting the Director’s day-to-day work.
kiswahili: Tina ni Msaidizi Binafsi wa Mkurugenzi wa Studies and Awards Limited, anayeunga mkono kazi za kila siku za Mkurugenzi.
translation: Tina ko Personal Assistant ab Director eng' Studies and Awards Limited, ne toretei Director eng' boisiet nenyin ab betut age tugul.

english: Tina is the Personal Assistant to the Director at Studies and Awards Limited, working closely with the Director on her day-to-day work.
kiswahili: Tina ni Msaidizi Binafsi wa Mkurugenzi wa Studies and Awards Limited, anayefanya kazi kwa karibu na Mkurugenzi katika kazi zake za kila siku.
translation: Tina ko Personal Assistant ab Director eng' Studies and Awards Limited, ne boisie negit ak Director eng' boisiet nenyin ab betut age tugul.

english: If you need to reach the Director, or to follow up on something she is handling, Tina is the person to ask.
kiswahili: Ukihitaji kumfikia Mkurugenzi, au kufuatilia jambo analoshughulikia, Tina ndiye mtu wa kuuliza.
translation: Ngo imache inyor Director, anan isub ng'olyon ne ripei, Tina ko chii ne iteebe.

english: Overseeing how your applications to universities and colleges abroad are prepared and submitted.
kiswahili: Kusimamia jinsi maombi yako kwa vyuo vikuu na vyuo vya nje yanavyoandaliwa na kuwasilishwa.
translation: Keret ab ole kichobei ak keyoktei aplikesheni cheng'ung' eng' univasitisiek ak kolejisiek ab sang' ab emet.

english: Winnie is the Application Manager at Studies and Awards Limited, overseeing how student applications are prepared and submitted.
kiswahili: Winnie ni Meneja wa Maombi wa Studies and Awards Limited, anayesimamia jinsi maombi ya wanafunzi yanavyoandaliwa na kuwasilishwa.
translation: Winnie ko Application Manager eng' Studies and Awards Limited, ne keerei ole kichobei ak keyoktei aplikesheni ab kipsomaninik.

english: Winnie is the Application Manager at Studies and Awards Limited, leading the Application Team and overseeing how students’ applications to partner universities and colleges abroad are prepared and submitted.
kiswahili: Winnie ni Meneja wa Maombi wa Studies and Awards Limited, anayeongoza Timu ya Maombi na kusimamia jinsi maombi ya wanafunzi kwa vyuo vikuu na vyuo washirika vya nje yanavyoandaliwa na kuwasilishwa.
translation: Winnie ko Application Manager eng' Studies and Awards Limited, ne indoi Timit ab Aplikesheni ak keerei ole kichobei ak keyoktei aplikesheni ab kipsomaninik eng' univasitisiek ak kolejisiek che kiboisie ak acheek eng' sang' ab emet.

english: Working alongside the rest of the team, Winnie helps make sure each application is complete and accurate before it goes out, so students avoid the delays that come from a missing document or a rushed form.
kiswahili: Akifanya kazi na timu nzima, Winnie husaidia kuhakikisha kila ombi ni kamili na sahihi kabla ya kutumwa, ili wanafunzi waepuke ucheleweshaji unaotokana na hati iliyokosekana au fomu iliyojazwa kwa haraka.
translation: Ye boisie ak timit tugul, Winnie kotoreti si kotar aplikesheni age tugul ak koek ne nyolu kotomo keyokte, si ma ketonon aplikesheni ab kipsomaninik amu karatasit ne ma mi anan fomit ne kakisir chokyi.

english: Guiding your applications to partner universities and colleges abroad.
kiswahili: Kuongoza maombi yako kwa vyuo vikuu na vyuo washirika vya nje.
translation: Koindochin eng' aplikesheni cheng'ung' eng' univasitisiek ak kolejisiek che kiboisie ak acheek eng' sang' ab emet.

english: Joy handles applications at Studies and Awards Limited, guiding students through their submissions to partner institutions.
kiswahili: Joy anashughulikia maombi katika Studies and Awards Limited, akiwaongoza wanafunzi katika uwasilishaji wao kwa taasisi washirika.
translation: Joy koripei aplikesheni eng' Studies and Awards Limited, ak koindoi kipsomaninik ye yoktei aplikesheni eng' sukulisiek che kiboisie ak acheek.

english: Joy works on Applications at Studies and Awards Limited, guiding students through their submissions to partner universities and colleges abroad.
kiswahili: Joy anafanya kazi kwenye Maombi katika Studies and Awards Limited, akiwaongoza wanafunzi katika uwasilishaji wao kwa vyuo vikuu na vyuo washirika vya nje.
translation: Joy koboisie eng' Aplikesheni eng' Studies and Awards Limited, ak koindoi kipsomaninik ye yoktei aplikesheni eng' univasitisiek ak kolejisiek che kiboisie ak acheek eng' sang' ab emet.

english: She checks each application for completeness and accuracy before it goes out, helping students avoid the delays that come from a missing document or a rushed form.
kiswahili: Hukagua kila ombi kwa ukamilifu na usahihi kabla ya kutumwa, akiwasaidia wanafunzi kuepuka ucheleweshaji unaotokana na hati iliyokosekana au fomu iliyojazwa kwa haraka.
translation: Kokeerei aplikesheni age tugul ile kakotar ak ko ne nyolu kotomo keyokte, kotoreti kipsomaninik si ma ketonon aplikesheni nenywa amu karatasit ne ma mi anan fomit ne kakisir chokyi.

english: Meeting the conditions on your offer letter, and the documents a school asks for before approving you.
kiswahili: Kutimiza masharti ya barua yako ya ofa, na nyaraka ambazo shule huomba kabla ya kukuidhinisha.
translation: Kayait ab ng'atutik che mi baruet neng'ung' ab ofa, ak karatasisiek che mache sukul kotomo koyan inyee.

english: Ian works in the Application Team at Studies and Awards Limited, making sure students meet their school’s GTE requirements and the conditions on their offer.
kiswahili: Ian anafanya kazi katika Timu ya Maombi ya Studies and Awards Limited, akihakikisha wanafunzi wanatimiza mahitaji ya GTE ya shule yao na masharti ya ofa yao.
translation: Ian koboisie eng' Timit ab Aplikesheni eng' Studies and Awards Limited, ak kokeerei ile kakoyai kipsomaninik tuguk che mache sukul eng' GTE ak ng'atutik che mi ofa nenywa.

english: Ian works in the Application Team at Studies and Awards Limited, looking after GTE preparation and assessments: the documents a school needs before it approves a student.
kiswahili: Ian anafanya kazi katika Timu ya Maombi ya Studies and Awards Limited, akishughulikia maandalizi na tathmini ya GTE: nyaraka ambazo shule inahitaji kabla ya kumwidhinisha mwanafunzi.
translation: Ian koboisie eng' Timit ab Aplikesheni eng' Studies and Awards Limited, ak koripei chobet ak keret ab GTE: karatasisiek che mache sukul kotomo koyan kipsomaniat.

english: Once a student has an offer, Ian makes sure every condition on it is met, works with the GSR team when the school asks for a statement of purpose, and sends everything back to the school.
kiswahili: Mwanafunzi akishapata ofa, Ian huhakikisha kila sharti lake limetimizwa, hufanya kazi na timu ya GSR shule inapoomba taarifa ya madhumuni, na hurudisha kila kitu shuleni.
translation: Ye kakonyor kipsomaniat ofa, Ian kokeerei ile kakiyai ng'atutik tugul che mi, koboisie ak timit ab GSR ye komache sukul statement of purpose, ak kogochi sukul tuguk tugul.

english: Rahab looks after Documentation at Studies and Awards Limited, helping students get their documents ready for their applications.
kiswahili: Rahab anashughulikia Nyaraka katika Studies and Awards Limited, akiwasaidia wanafunzi kuandaa nyaraka zao kwa maombi.
translation: Rahab koripei Karatasisiek eng' Studies and Awards Limited, kotoreti kipsomaninik kochob karatasisiek nenywa ab aplikesheni.

english: Rahab Cherono looks after Documentation at Studies and Awards Limited, helping students prepare and organise the documents their applications need.
kiswahili: Rahab Cherono anashughulikia Nyaraka katika Studies and Awards Limited, akiwasaidia wanafunzi kuandaa na kupanga nyaraka ambazo maombi yao yanahitaji.
translation: Rahab Cherono koripei Karatasisiek eng' Studies and Awards Limited, kotoreti kipsomaninik kochob ak koiten karatasisiek che mache aplikesheni nenywa.

english: She works with students to make sure their files are complete, so their applications are ready to move forward.
kiswahili: Hufanya kazi na wanafunzi kuhakikisha mafaili yao ni kamili, ili maombi yao yawe tayari kusonga mbele.
translation: Koboisie ak kipsomaninik si kotar faili nenywa, si koek aplikesheni nenywa che kakichob kowe tai.

english: Leading the review of your documents so applications go out complete and accurate.
kiswahili: Kuongoza ukaguzi wa nyaraka zako ili maombi yatumwe yakiwa kamili na sahihi.
translation: Koindoi keret ab karatasisiek cheng'ung' si keyokte aplikesheni che kakotar ak che nyolu.

english: Canisius is the Compliance and Verification Manager at Studies and Awards Limited, making sure every application meets the required standards.
kiswahili: Canisius ni Meneja wa Uzingatiaji na Uthibitishaji wa Studies and Awards Limited, anayehakikisha kila ombi linatimiza viwango vinavyohitajika.
translation: Canisius ko Compliance and Verification Manager eng' Studies and Awards Limited, ne keerei ile kakoyai aplikesheni age tugul tuguk tugul che mache.

english: Canisius Yego is the Compliance and Verification Manager at Studies and Awards Limited, leading the team that reviews student documentation before it’s submitted to partner institutions and visa authorities.
kiswahili: Canisius Yego ni Meneja wa Uzingatiaji na Uthibitishaji wa Studies and Awards Limited, anayeongoza timu inayokagua nyaraka za wanafunzi kabla hazijawasilishwa kwa taasisi washirika na mamlaka za visa.
translation: Canisius Yego ko Compliance and Verification Manager eng' Studies and Awards Limited, ne indoi timit ne keerei karatasisiek ab kipsomaninik kotomo keyokte eng' sukulisiek che kiboisie ak acheek ak biik che ripei visa.

english: His focus is on accuracy and accountability: making sure every file is complete, verified and compliant, so students’ applications go out right the first time.
kiswahili: Lengo lake ni usahihi na uwajibikaji: kuhakikisha kila faili ni kamili, imethibitishwa na inazingatia sheria, ili maombi ya wanafunzi yatumwe sawasawa mara ya kwanza.
translation: Kiy ne kabwatei missing ko ile koek tuguk ne nyolu ak ile kotinye chii ne ripei: koker ile kakotar faili age tugul, kakigimit ak kakoyai ng'atutik tugul, si keyokte aplikesheni ab kipsomaninik komie eng' kasarta ne tai.

english: Dennis handles compliance and verification at Studies and Awards Limited, making sure every application meets the right standards.
kiswahili: Dennis anashughulikia uzingatiaji na uthibitishaji katika Studies and Awards Limited, akihakikisha kila ombi linatimiza viwango sahihi.
translation: Dennis koripei compliance ak kegimitet eng' Studies and Awards Limited, ne keerei ile kakoyai aplikesheni age tugul tuguk che nyolu.

english: Dennis works in Verification and Compliance at Studies and Awards Limited, reviewing student documentation before it’s submitted to partner institutions and visa authorities.
kiswahili: Dennis anafanya kazi katika Uthibitishaji na Uzingatiaji wa Studies and Awards Limited, akikagua nyaraka za wanafunzi kabla hazijawasilishwa kwa taasisi washirika na mamlaka za visa.
translation: Dennis koboisie eng' Kegimitet ak Compliance eng' Studies and Awards Limited, ne keerei karatasisiek ab kipsomaninik kotomo keyokte eng' sukulisiek che kiboisie ak acheek ak biik che ripei visa.

english: His work is about catching errors and missing paperwork early, so applications go out complete and accurate the first time.
kiswahili: Kazi yake ni kukamata makosa na karatasi zilizokosekana mapema, ili maombi yatumwe yakiwa kamili na sahihi mara ya kwanza.
translation: Boisiet nenyin ko konyor ng'olyosiek ak karatasisiek che ma mi kotomo kowe tai, si keyokte aplikesheni che kakotar ak che nyolu eng' kasarta ne tai.

english: Your visa application, and the day-to-day running of the team.
kiswahili: Ombi lako la visa, na uendeshaji wa kila siku wa timu.
translation: Aplikesheni neng'ung' ab visa, ak boisiet ab timit ab betut age tugul.

english: Mourine is the General Manager at Studies and Awards Limited and works in the Visa department, overseeing the team’s day-to-day work.
kiswahili: Mourine ni Meneja Mkuu wa Studies and Awards Limited na anafanya kazi katika idara ya Visa, akisimamia kazi za kila siku za timu.
translation: Mourine ko General Manager eng' Studies and Awards Limited ak koboisie eng' idara ab Visa, ne keerei boisiet ab timit ab betut age tugul.

english: Mourine is the General Manager at Studies and Awards Limited, overseeing day-to-day operations across every destination the company supports.
kiswahili: Mourine ni Meneja Mkuu wa Studies and Awards Limited, anayesimamia shughuli za kila siku katika kila nchi ambayo kampuni inahudumia.
translation: Mourine ko General Manager eng' Studies and Awards Limited, ne keerei boisiet ab betut age tugul eng' emotinwek tugul che toretei kampuni.

english: She also works in the Visa department, guiding students through their visa applications, and works across departments to keep applications, compliance and client communication running smoothly.
kiswahili: Pia hufanya kazi katika idara ya Visa, akiwaongoza wanafunzi katika maombi yao ya visa, na hufanya kazi kati ya idara ili maombi, uzingatiaji na mawasiliano na wateja viende vizuri.
translation: Koboisie kora eng' idara ab Visa, koindoi kipsomaninik eng' aplikesheni nenywa ab visa, ak koboisie ak idarasiek tugul si kowe tai komie aplikesheni, compliance ak ng'alalet ak biik.

english: Your visa application, and making sure nothing is missed on your file.
kiswahili: Ombi lako la visa, na kuhakikisha hakuna kinachokosekana kwenye faili lako.
translation: Aplikesheni neng'ung' ab visa, ak kegeer ile mi tuguk tugul eng' faili neng'ung'.

english: Joyner is the Assistant General Manager at Studies and Awards Limited and works in the Visa department, supporting operations across the team.
kiswahili: Joyner ni Naibu Meneja Mkuu wa Studies and Awards Limited na anafanya kazi katika idara ya Visa, akisaidia shughuli katika timu.
translation: Joyner ko Assistant General Manager eng' Studies and Awards Limited ak koboisie eng' idara ab Visa, kotoreti boisiet eng' timit tugul.

english: Joyner is the Assistant General Manager at Studies and Awards Limited, supporting the General Manager in coordinating the team’s daily operations.
kiswahili: Joyner ni Naibu Meneja Mkuu wa Studies and Awards Limited, anayemsaidia Meneja Mkuu kuratibu shughuli za kila siku za timu.
translation: Joyner ko Assistant General Manager eng' Studies and Awards Limited, ne toretei General Manager koiten boisiet ab timit ab betut age tugul.

english: She also works in the Visa department, guiding students through their visa applications, and helps keep the departments working together so nothing falls through the cracks on a student’s file.
kiswahili: Pia hufanya kazi katika idara ya Visa, akiwaongoza wanafunzi katika maombi yao ya visa, na husaidia idara kufanya kazi pamoja ili hakuna kinachopotea kwenye faili la mwanafunzi.
translation: Koboisie kora eng' idara ab Visa, koindoi kipsomaninik eng' aplikesheni nenywa ab visa, ak kotoreti idarasiek koboisie kobooto si komi tuguk tugul eng' faili ab kipsomaniat.

english: The GSR part of your application, and keeping the office running smoothly.
kiswahili: Sehemu ya GSR ya ombi lako, na kuweka ofisi ikiendelea vizuri.
translation: Hatua ab GSR eng' aplikesheni neng'ung', ak keret ile kowe tai komie boisiet ab ofisit.

english: Beatrice is the Assistant Manager at Studies and Awards Limited and works in the GSR department.
kiswahili: Beatrice ni Meneja Msaidizi wa Studies and Awards Limited na anafanya kazi katika idara ya GSR.
translation: Beatrice ko Assistant Manager eng' Studies and Awards Limited ak koboisie eng' idara ab GSR.

english: Beatrice is the Assistant Manager at Studies and Awards Limited, supporting the day-to-day running of the office and the wider team.
kiswahili: Beatrice ni Meneja Msaidizi wa Studies and Awards Limited, anayeunga mkono uendeshaji wa kila siku wa ofisi na timu pana.
translation: Beatrice ko Assistant Manager eng' Studies and Awards Limited, ne toretei boisiet ab ofisit ak timit tugul ab betut age tugul.

english: She also works in the GSR department, helping students with this part of their application.
kiswahili: Pia hufanya kazi katika idara ya GSR, akiwasaidia wanafunzi katika sehemu hii ya ombi lao.
translation: Koboisie kora eng' idara ab GSR, kotoreti kipsomaninik eng' hatua ni ab aplikesheni nenywa.

english: Tebby handles Accounts and Human Resources at Studies and Awards Limited, keeping the company’s finances and staff matters in order.
kiswahili: Tebby anashughulikia Hesabu na Rasilimali Watu katika Studies and Awards Limited, akiweka fedha na masuala ya wafanyakazi wa kampuni katika mpangilio.
translation: Tebby koripei Accounts ak Human Resources eng' Studies and Awards Limited, ak koripei rabinik ab kampuni ak ng'alek ab timit si koek komie.

english: Tebby handles Accounts and Human Resources at Studies and Awards Limited, managing the company’s day-to-day finances and looking after staff matters.
kiswahili: Tebby anashughulikia Hesabu na Rasilimali Watu katika Studies and Awards Limited, akisimamia fedha za kila siku za kampuni na kutunza masuala ya wafanyakazi.
translation: Tebby koripei Accounts ak Human Resources eng' Studies and Awards Limited, ak keerei rabinik ab kampuni ab betut age tugul ak ng'alek ab timit.

english: For students, she is the person to ask about payments and fees, keeping things organised behind the scenes so the counselling team can focus on students.
kiswahili: Kwa wanafunzi, ndiye mtu wa kuuliza kuhusu malipo na ada, akiweka mambo katika mpangilio nyuma ya pazia ili timu ya ushauri iangazie wanafunzi.
translation: Eng' kipsomaninik, ineendet ko chii ne iteebe agobo lipanet ak robinik ab sukul. Koiten tuguk eng' let si kotinye timit ab kirwoget kasarta ab kipsomaninik.

english: Support for your wellbeing as you prepare for a move abroad.
kiswahili: Msaada kwa ustawi wako unapojiandaa kuhamia nje ya nchi.
translation: Toretet ab sobet neng'ung' ye ichobgei kowendi sang' ab emet.

english: Collins works on Masomo Welfare at Studies and Awards Limited, supporting students’ wellbeing throughout their studies.
kiswahili: Collins anafanya kazi kwenye Masomo Welfare katika Studies and Awards Limited, akiunga mkono ustawi wa wanafunzi katika masomo yao yote.
translation: Collins koboisie eng' Masomo Welfare eng' Studies and Awards Limited, kotoreti sobet ab kipsomaninik eng' somanet nenywa tugul.

english: Collins works on Masomo Welfare at Studies and Awards Limited, supporting students’ wellbeing throughout their time working with the company.
kiswahili: Collins anafanya kazi kwenye Masomo Welfare katika Studies and Awards Limited, akiunga mkono ustawi wa wanafunzi katika muda wote wa kufanya kazi na kampuni.
translation: Collins koboisie eng' Masomo Welfare eng' Studies and Awards Limited, kotoreti sobet ab kipsomaninik eng' kasarta tugul ne boisie ak kampuni.

english: He checks in with students beyond the paperwork, making sure they feel supported as they prepare for a major move abroad.
kiswahili: Huwasiliana na wanafunzi zaidi ya karatasi, akihakikisha wanahisi kuungwa mkono wanapojiandaa kwa hatua kubwa ya kuhamia nje ya nchi.
translation: Kongalalei ak kipsomaninik kosiir karatasisiek, si konai kipsomaninik ile kitoretei ye chobgei kowendi sang' ab emet.

english: Questions about Magister Sacco, and financial support for school fees.
kiswahili: Maswali kuhusu Magister Sacco, na msaada wa kifedha kwa ada za shule.
translation: Teebutik agobo Magister Sacco, ak toretet ab rabinik eng' robinik ab sukul.

english: John Talaam works in Administration at Studies and Awards Limited, looking after Magister Sacco.
kiswahili: John Talaam anafanya kazi katika Utawala wa Studies and Awards Limited, akishughulikia Magister Sacco.
translation: John Talaam koboisie eng' Administration eng' Studies and Awards Limited, ak koripei Magister Sacco.

english: John Talaam works in the Administration department at Studies and Awards Limited, looking after Magister Sacco.
kiswahili: John Talaam anafanya kazi katika idara ya Utawala ya Studies and Awards Limited, akishughulikia Magister Sacco.
translation: John Talaam koboisie eng' idara ab Administration eng' Studies and Awards Limited, ak koripei Magister Sacco.

english: If you have a question about Magister Sacco, John is the person to ask.
kiswahili: Ukiwa na swali kuhusu Magister Sacco, John ndiye mtu wa kuuliza.
translation: Ngo itinye teebutiet agobo Magister Sacco, John ko chii ne iteebe.

english: Keeping the day-to-day running of the office and student processes on track.
kiswahili: Kuweka uendeshaji wa kila siku wa ofisi na michakato ya wanafunzi katika mstari.
translation: Keret si kowe tai komie boisiet ab ofisit ab betut age tugul ak oratinwek ab kipsomaninik.

english: Bethwel works in Operations at Studies and Awards Limited, helping keep the team’s day-to-day work running smoothly.
kiswahili: Bethwel anafanya kazi katika Uendeshaji wa Studies and Awards Limited, akisaidia kazi za kila siku za timu ziende vizuri.
translation: Bethwel koboisie eng' Operations eng' Studies and Awards Limited, kotoreti si kowe tai komie boisiet ab timit ab betut age tugul.

english: Bethwel works in Operations at Studies and Awards Limited, helping keep the company’s day-to-day work running smoothly.
kiswahili: Bethwel anafanya kazi katika Uendeshaji wa Studies and Awards Limited, akisaidia kazi za kila siku za kampuni ziende vizuri.
translation: Bethwel koboisie eng' Operations eng' Studies and Awards Limited, kotoreti si kowe tai komie boisiet ab kampuni ab betut age tugul.

english: Behind the scenes, Bethwel supports the departments students deal with directly, so the process from first enquiry to enrolment stays organised.
kiswahili: Nyuma ya pazia, Bethwel huunga mkono idara ambazo wanafunzi hushughulika nazo moja kwa moja, ili mchakato kutoka swali la kwanza hadi kujiandikisha uwe wa mpangilio.
translation: Eng' let, Bethwel kotoreti idarasiek che boisie ak kipsomaninik eng' tai, si kotesei kotinye oret ne kararan kong'eten teebutiet ne tai agoi ye kakochut kipsomaniat sukul.

english: Preparing for the IELTS and PTE English tests.
kiswahili: Kujiandaa kwa mitihani ya Kiingereza ya IELTS na PTE.
translation: Chobet ab tiemutik ab Kiingereza ab IELTS ak PTE.

english: Witney tutors IELTS and PTE at Studies and Awards Limited, preparing students for the language requirements of their destination.
kiswahili: Witney anafundisha IELTS na PTE katika Studies and Awards Limited, akiwaandaa wanafunzi kwa mahitaji ya lugha ya nchi yao.
translation: Witney koneti IELTS ak PTE eng' Studies and Awards Limited, kochobei kipsomaninik eng' tuguk ab kutit che mache emotinwek nenywa.

english: Witney is the IELTS and PTE Tutor at Studies and Awards Limited, preparing students for the English-language tests most destinations require before they can enrol.
kiswahili: Witney ni Mkufunzi wa IELTS na PTE wa Studies and Awards Limited, akiwaandaa wanafunzi kwa mitihani ya Kiingereza ambayo nchi nyingi huhitaji kabla ya kujiandikisha.
translation: Witney ko Konetindet ab IELTS ak PTE eng' Studies and Awards Limited, kochobei kipsomaninik eng' tiemutik ab Kiingereza che mache emotinwek chechang' kotomo kochut sukul.

english: She works with students individually and in groups, building test-taking skills and confidence so they can meet the score their chosen university or visa needs.
kiswahili: Hufanya kazi na wanafunzi mmoja mmoja na katika vikundi, akijenga ujuzi wa kufanya mtihani na kujiamini ili wafikie alama ambayo chuo kikuu au visa waliyochagua inahitaji.
translation: Koboisie ak kipsomaninik agenge agenge ak eng' kurubeek, ak kotesei kimnatet nenywa eng' tiemutik si konyor maksisiek che mache univasiti anan visa ne kakolewen.

english: Learning German, and guidance on studying in Germany.
kiswahili: Kujifunza Kijerumani, na mwongozo wa kusoma Ujerumani.
translation: Somanet ab Kijerumani, ak kirwoget agobo somanet eng' Ujerumani.

english: Karen is the German Language Tutor at Studies and Awards Limited, and also guides students who are considering Germany as a destination.
kiswahili: Karen ni Mkufunzi wa Lugha ya Kijerumani wa Studies and Awards Limited, na pia huwaongoza wanafunzi wanaofikiria Ujerumani kama nchi ya kusoma.

english: Ready to study in United Kingdom?
World-renowned universities and a rich academic tradition, with degrees that often take less time than elsewhere.
kiswahili: Vyuo vikuu maarufu duniani na mila tajiri ya elimu, na shahada ambazo mara nyingi huchukua muda mfupi kuliko kwingine.
translation: Univasitisiek che kigen eng' ng'wony ak somanet ne bo keny, ak degrisiek chechang' che ma nami kasarta ne koi kosiir ole age.

english: Home to more than 170 museums, many of which offer free admission, including the British Museum.
kiswahili: Nyumbani kwa zaidi ya makumbusho 170, mengi yakiruhusu kuingia bila malipo, ikiwemo British Museum.
translation: Ole mi museums kosiir 170, che chechang' ko ma kelipani si ichut, kobooto British Museum.

english: Hosts the Edinburgh Festival Fringe, the largest annual arts festival in the world.
kiswahili: Huandaa Edinburgh Festival Fringe, tamasha kubwa zaidi la sanaa la kila mwaka duniani.
translation: Ole kiyaei Edinburgh Festival Fringe, tuiyet ne oo missing ab sanaa ne kiyaei kenyit age tugul eng' ng'wony.

english: Scotland's largest city, celebrated for its Victorian and Art Nouveau architecture.
kiswahili: Jiji kubwa zaidi la Scotland, linalosifiwa kwa usanifu wake wa enzi ya Victoria na Art Nouveau.
translation: Taunit ne oo missing eng' Scotland, ne kigen amu korik nenyin ab Victorian ak Art Nouveau.

english: The UK's second-largest city, with more miles of canal than Venice.
kiswahili: Jiji la pili kwa ukubwa Uingereza, lenye maili nyingi zaidi za mifereji kuliko Venice.
translation: Taunit ne oo ne bo aeng' eng' UK, ne tinye canals che koi kosiir che mi Venice.

english: One of the UK's largest financial centres outside London, built on a Victorian textile legacy.
kiswahili: Mojawapo ya vituo vikubwa vya fedha vya Uingereza nje ya London, vilivyojengwa juu ya urithi wa nguo wa enzi ya Victoria.
translation: Agenge eng' taunisiek che echen missing ab rabinik eng' UK ko ma London, ne kichob eng' boisiet ab ngoroik ab kasarta ab Victorian.

english: Home to the University of Cambridge, founded in 1209 and one of the oldest universities in the world.
kiswahili: Nyumbani kwa Chuo Kikuu cha Cambridge, kilichoanzishwa mwaka 1209 na mojawapo ya vyuo vikuu vikongwe zaidi duniani.
translation: Ole mi University of Cambridge, ne kitaun eng' 1209 ak ne mi agenge eng' univasitisiek che bo keny missing eng' ng'wony.

english: A major port city on the south coast, from where the RMS Titanic set sail in 1912, and home to the University of Southampton.
kiswahili: Jiji kubwa la bandari pwani ya kusini, ambako meli ya RMS Titanic iliondoka mwaka 1912, na nyumbani kwa Chuo Kikuu cha Southampton.
translation: Taunit ne oo ab bandari ne mi kusini, ole ki kobunu RMS Titanic eng' 1912, ak ole mi University of Southampton.

english: A historic East Anglian city with a Norman cathedral and castle, and England's first UNESCO City of Literature.
kiswahili: Jiji la kihistoria la East Anglia lenye kanisa kuu na ngome ya Norman, na Jiji la kwanza la Fasihi la UNESCO nchini Uingereza.
translation: Taunit ne bo keny eng' East Anglia ne tinye cathedral ak castle ab Norman, ak ko England's first UNESCO City of Literature (taunit ne tai eng' England ne kigure kou noton).

english: A cathedral city on the River Nene in the East of England, with fast rail links to London.
kiswahili: Jiji la kanisa kuu kando ya Mto Nene mashariki mwa Uingereza, lenye reli za haraka kwenda London.
translation: Taunit ab cathedral ne mi kobo River Nene eng' East of England, ne tinye trains che wendi chokyi agoi London.

english: The capital of Northern Ireland, where the RMS Titanic was built, now home to the Titanic Belfast visitor experience.
kiswahili: Mji mkuu wa Ireland Kaskazini, ambako meli ya RMS Titanic ilijengwa, sasa ukiwa na kivutio cha wageni cha Titanic Belfast.
translation: Taunit ne oo ab serikali ab Northern Ireland, ole ki kichob RMS Titanic, ak raini ole mi Titanic Belfast ne kibunu biik che chomei.

english: Also known as Derry, a Northern Ireland city whose 17th-century walls are the most complete city walls in Ireland.
kiswahili: Pia linajulikana kama Derry, jiji la Ireland Kaskazini lenye kuta za karne ya 17 ambazo ni kuta kamili zaidi za jiji nchini Ireland.
translation: Kigure kora Derry, taunit ab Northern Ireland ne tinye irimeek ab 17th century che bo taunit che kararan missing eng' Ayalandi tugul.

english: Home to some of the world's oldest and most respected universities, offering globally recognised degrees.
kiswahili: Nyumbani kwa baadhi ya vyuo vikuu vikongwe na vinavyoheshimika zaidi duniani, vinavyotoa shahada zinazotambuliwa kote.
translation: Ole mi univasitisiek alak che bo keny missing ak che kiboiboitu missing eng' ng'wony, che gochei degrisiek che kiyan eng' ng'wony tugul.

english: Thousands of courses across universities and colleges, from foundation programmes to master's degrees.
kiswahili: Maelfu ya kozi katika vyuo vikuu na vyuo, kuanzia programu za msingi hadi shahada za uzamili.
translation: Kosisiek eliphuusyek eng' univasitisiek ak kolejisiek, kong'eten foundation programmes agoi master's degrees.
Programisiek ab degrii che ma koi

english: Many undergraduate degrees run three years and taught master's degrees just one, reducing overall time and cost.
kiswahili: Shahada nyingi za kwanza huchukua miaka mitatu na shahada za uzamili za kufundishwa mwaka mmoja tu, na hivyo kupunguza muda na gharama.
translation: Degrisiek chechang' ab taunet konamei kenyisiek somok, ak taught master's degrees kenyit agenge kityo, si ma kinam kasarta ne koi ak robinik chechang'.
Somanet ne bo keny ne kararan

english: Multicultural cities with centuries of academic history and a huge range of course specialisations.
kiswahili: Miji yenye tamaduni nyingi na historia ya karne nyingi ya elimu, na taaluma nyingi tofauti za kozi.
translation: Taunisiek ab biik ab ortinwek chechang' che tinye somanet ab kenyisiek pogol chechang', ak kosisiek chechang' missing che terterchin.

english: You apply for a Student visa once your university, a licensed student sponsor, gives you a Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS). You must show you can pay your course fees and living costs and prove your English, usually at level B2 for a degree. Applicants who live in Kenya also need a tuberculosis (TB) test certificate from an approved clinic.
kiswahili: Unaomba Visa ya mwanafunzi mara chuo chako kikuu, ambacho ni mdhamini wa wanafunzi mwenye leseni, kinapokupa Uthibitisho wa Kukubaliwa kwa Masomo (CAS). Lazima uonyeshe unaweza kulipa ada za kozi na gharama za maisha na uthibitishe Kiingereza chako, kwa kawaida kiwango cha B2 kwa shahada. Waombaji wanaoishi Kenya pia wanahitaji cheti cha kipimo cha kifua kikuu (TB) kutoka kliniki iliyoidhinishwa.
translation: Isomei Student visa ye kakogochin univasiti neng'ung', ne tinye licence ab student sponsor, Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS). Imache iboru ile imuchi ilipan robinik ab kozi ak robinik ab sobet, ak iboru Kiingereza neng'ung', chechang' ko kiwendi ab B2 eng' degrii. Biik che mi Kenya che somei visa komache kora tuberculosis (TB) test certificate kong'eten clinic ne kakiyan.

english: Current visa fees, financial-evidence thresholds and the Immigration Health Surcharge are set by UK Visas and Immigration and change from time to time.
kiswahili: Ada za sasa za visa, viwango vya ushahidi wa fedha na Ada ya Huduma ya Afya ya Wahamiaji huwekwa na UK Visas and Immigration na hubadilika mara kwa mara.
translation: Robinik ab visa che mi raini, robinik che imache iboru ak Immigration Health Surcharge kochobei UK Visas and Immigration, ak kowalaksei kasarta ak kasarta.
